title.zh: 卷528 列傳三百十五 属国傳三 缅甸 暹罗 南掌 苏禄
title.en: Volume 528 Biographies 315: Tributary State Biographies 3: Burma, Siam, Lan Xang, Sulu
title.raw: 卷528 列傳三百十五 属国傳三 缅甸 暹罗 南掌 苏禄

sentences.zh: 緬甸，在雲南永昌府騰越廳邊外，而順寧、普洱諸邊皆與緬甸界。

translations.literal: Burma lies beyond the border of Tengyue sub-prefecture in Yongchang prefecture, Yunnan, and the frontiers of Shunning, Pu'er, and other districts all border Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Burma lay beyond the frontier of Tengyue sub-prefecture in Yunnan's Yongchang prefecture; the borders of Shunning, Pu'er, and neighboring districts all adjoined it.

sentences.zh: 順治十八年，李定國挾明桂王硃由榔入緬，詔公愛星阿偕吳三桂以兵萬八千人臨之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi, Li Dingguo took the Ming Prince of Gui, Zhu Youlang, into Burma. An edict ordered Prince Aidé Xing'a together with Wu Sangui to advance with eighteen thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi (1661), Li Dingguo escorted the Ming Prince of Gui, Zhu Youlang, into Burma. The court ordered Prince Aidé Xing'a and Wu Sangui to march against them with eighteen thousand men.

sentences.zh: 李定國走孟艮，不食死。

translations.literal: Li Dingguo fled to Menggen and died by refusing food.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dingguo fled to Menggen, where he starved himself to death.

sentences.zh: 緬酋莽應時縛由榔以獻，遂班師。

translations.literal: The Burmese chief Mang Yingshi bound Youlang and presented him as tribute, whereupon the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese ruler Mang Yingshi seized Youlang and handed him over; the Qing forces then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 緬自是不通中國者六七十年。

translations.literal: From then on Burma had no contact with China for some sixty or seventy years.
translations.idiomatic: After that Burma remained cut off from China for some sixty or seventy years.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，緬與景邁交閧，景邁使至普洱求貢，乞視南掌、暹羅，雲貴總督鄂爾泰疑而卻之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng, Burma and Keng Tung clashed. Keng Tung sent envoys to Pu'er to request tribute status, asking to be treated like Lan Xang and Siam. The Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Ortai was suspicious and refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Yongzheng (1731), Burma and Keng Tung fell into conflict. Keng Tung sent envoys to Pu'er seeking tributary status on the same terms as Lan Xang and Siam, but Governor-General Ortai, suspicious, turned them away.

sentences.zh: 緬密遣人至車裏土司，探知景邁貢被卻，則大喜，揚言緬來歲亦入貢。

translations.literal: Burma secretly sent men to the Cheli chieftaincy, learned that Keng Tung's tribute mission had been refused, rejoiced greatly, and proclaimed that Burma too would present tribute the following year.
translations.idiomatic: Burma secretly sent agents to the Cheli chieftaincy and, learning that Keng Tung's tribute bid had been rejected, was delighted and announced that Burma would also send tribute the next year.

sentences.zh: 旋興兵二萬攻景邁，而貢竟不至。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward it raised twenty thousand troops to attack Keng Tung, yet the promised tribute never came.
translations.idiomatic: It soon mobilized twenty thousand men to attack Keng Tung, but the promised tribute mission never materialized.

sentences.zh: 緬地亙數千里，其酋居阿瓦城。

translations.literal: Burmese territory extends for several thousand li; its chief resides in the city of Ava.
translations.idiomatic: Burmese lands stretched for thousands of li; its ruler dwelt in Ava.

sentences.zh: 城西瀕大金沙江。

translations.literal: West of the city lies the great Irrawaddy River.
translations.idiomatic: The city stood on the west bank of the great Irrawaddy.

sentences.zh: 江發源野人番地，縱貫其國中，南注於海。

translations.literal: The river rises in wild tribal lands, runs the length of the country, and flows south into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The river rose in the hill country of wild tribes, ran the length of Burma, and emptied south into the sea.

sentences.zh: 沿海富魚鹽，緬人載之，溯江上行十餘日，抵老官屯、新街、蠻暮粥市，邊內外諸夷人皆賴之。

translations.literal: The coast is rich in fish and salt. Burmese carry these goods upstream for more than ten days to reach Laoguantun, Xinjie, and the market at Manmu, on which tribesmen inside and outside the border all depend.
translations.idiomatic: The coast was rich in fish and salt. Burmese boatmen carried these goods upriver for ten days or more to Laoguantun, Xinjie, and the market town of Manmu—staples on which frontier peoples on both sides of the border relied.

sentences.zh: 而江以東為孟密，有寶井，產寶石。

translations.literal: East of the river lies Mengmi, which has a gem well that produces precious stones.
translations.idiomatic: East of the river lay Mengmi, site of a gem pit famed for its precious stones.

sentences.zh: 又有波龍者，產銀，江西、湖廣及雲南大理、永昌人出邊商販者甚眾，且屯聚波龍以開銀礦為生，常不下數萬人。

translations.literal: There is also Bolong, which produces silver. Many traders from Jiangxi, Huguang, and Yunnan's Dali and Yongchang crossed the border to trade, and crowds settled at Bolong to live by mining silver—often no fewer than tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Farther on was Bolong, a silver-producing district. Traders from Jiangxi, Huguang, and Yunnan's Dali and Yongchang flocked across the border in great numbers, and tens of thousands often settled at Bolong to work the silver mines for a living.

sentences.zh: 自波龍迤東有茂隆廠，亦產銀。

translations.literal: East of Bolong lies the Maolong mining district, which also produces silver.
translations.idiomatic: East of Bolong lay the Maolong mining district, another silver-producing area.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十年，葫蘆酋長以廠獻，遂為內地屬，然其地與緬犬牙相錯。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Qianlong, the Hulu chieftain presented the mine as tribute, and it became part of the interior domains, yet its territory interlocked with Burma's like dog's teeth.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Qianlong (1745), the Hulu chieftain offered up the mine, and the district was incorporated into Qing territory, though its lands still interlocked with Burma in a jagged checkerboard.

sentences.zh: 十八年，廠長吳尚賢思挾緬自重，說緬入貢，緬酋麻哈祖乃以馴象、塗金塔遣使叩關，雲南布政司等議卻之，而巡撫圖爾炳阿遽以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the mine director Wu Shangxian hoped to use Burma to bolster his own position and urged Burma to send tribute. The Burmese chief Mahazu then sent envoys bearing tame elephants and a gilded pagoda to knock at the pass. The Yunnan provincial administration commission and others debated refusing them, but Grand Coordinator Tu'erbing'a hastily reported the matter to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1753), mine director Wu Shangxian sought to strengthen his hand by persuading Burma to offer tribute. Burmese ruler Mahazu sent envoys with tame elephants and a gilded pagoda to the border pass. Yunnan's provincial administration commission favored turning them away, but Grand Coordinator Tu'erbing'a promptly reported the mission to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 帝下禮部議，如他屬國入貢例。

translations.literal: The emperor referred the matter to the Ministry of Rites, which ruled that Burma should be received according to the precedent for other tributary states.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to deliberate, and it ruled that Burma should be received under the same procedures as other tributary states.

sentences.zh: 其冬，緬使還至順甯，聞白古部酋撒翁起兵攻緬，緬兵敗，麻哈祖逃至約提朗，為白古所得，沉之江。

translations.literal: That winter, as the Burmese envoys returned to Shunning, they heard that the Pegu chieftain Sa-ong had raised troops against Burma. The Burmese army was defeated; Mahazu fled to Yotilang, was captured by Pegu, and was drowned in the river.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on their return to Shunning, the Burmese envoys learned that Pegu's chief Sa-ong had risen in revolt. Burma's army was beaten; Mahazu fled to Yotilang, was seized by Pegu, and drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 撒翁據阿瓦五年，而緬屬之木梳頭目甕藉牙復起兵攻走白古，自據其地，令頭目播定鮓等以兵脅諸部役屬之。

translations.literal: Sa-ong held Ava for five years, but the Mokso headman Yunxieya, a Burmese subject, again raised troops, drove out Pegu, seized the territory himself, and ordered subordinates such as Bodin Zha to coerce the various tribes into submission.
translations.idiomatic: Sa-ong held Ava for five years until Yunxieya, a Mokso headman under Burmese rule, rebelled, expelled Pegu, and took Ava for himself, sending officers such as Bodin Zha to coerce the surrounding tribes into vassalage.

sentences.zh: 既而甕藉牙死，子懵洛立。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Yunxieya died and his son Mengluo succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Yunxieya soon died, and his son Mengluo succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，亦死，弟懵駁立。

translations.literal: Before long he too died, and his younger brother Mengbo succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: He too died not long after, and his younger brother Mengbo took the throne.

sentences.zh: 貴家者，隨永明入緬之官族也，其子孫自相署曰「貴家」，據波龍廠采銀。

translations.literal: The Guijia were an official clan that had followed the Southern Ming into Burma; their descendants styled themselves the "Noble House" and held Bolong to mine silver.
translations.idiomatic: The Guijia were officials who had followed the Southern Ming into Burma; their descendants called themselves the "Noble House" and controlled silver mining at Bolong.

sentences.zh: 其酋宮裏雁不附於甕藉牙，約木邦酋攻之。

translations.literal: Their chief Gongliyan refused to submit to Yunxieya and allied with the Mohnyin chieftain to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Their chief Gongliyan refused to submit to Yunxieya and joined the Mohnyin chieftain in an attack on Burma.

sentences.zh: 兵敗，逃入孟連，而孟連土司刀派春奪其孥賄，為宮酋妻囊占所襲殺。

translations.literal: Defeated in battle, he fled into Menglian, where the Menglian chieftain Dao Paichun seized his family as ransom; Gongliyan's wife Nang Zhan then ambushed and killed Dao Paichun.
translations.idiomatic: After his defeat he fled to Menglian, where chieftain Dao Paichun seized his family for ransom; Gongliyan's wife Nang Zhan ambushed and killed Dao Paichun.

sentences.zh: 雲貴總督吳達善誘宮裏雁至，則坐以擾邊罪，肆諸市。

translations.literal: The Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Wu Dashan lured Gongliyan to come, then convicted him of disturbing the frontier and had him dismembered in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Wu Dashan lured Gongliyan in, convicted him of frontier disturbances, and had him executed by dismemberment in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 而木邦酋罕莽底亦兵敗走死，懵駁立其弟罕黑。

translations.literal: The Mohnyin chieftain Han Mangdi was also defeated in battle and died in flight; Mengbo installed his younger brother Han Hei in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Mohnyin chieftain Han Mangdi was likewise defeated and killed in flight; Mengbo installed Han Mangdi's younger brother Han Hei as ruler.

sentences.zh: 由是緬人益無忌。

translations.literal: From this the Burmese grew ever more unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the Burmese grew ever bolder.

sentences.zh: 明萬曆時，巡撫陳用賓因永昌府近緬，設八關控之。

translations.literal: In the Wanli reign of the Ming, Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin, because Yongchang prefecture lay close to Burma, established eight passes to control the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: During the Ming Wanli reign, Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin, noting that Yongchang lay close to Burma, established eight frontier passes to control access.

sentences.zh: 八關者，萬仞、巨石、神護、銅壁、鐵壁、虎踞、天馬、漢龍也。

translations.literal: The eight passes were Wanyin, Jushi, Shenhu, Tongbi, Tiebi, Huju, Tianma, and Hanlong.
translations.idiomatic: The eight passes were Wanyin, Jushi, Shenhu, Tongbi, Tiebi, Huju, Tianma, and Hanlong.

sentences.zh: 其實八關皆無險阨可守，山箐間小徑往往通人行。

translations.literal: In truth none of the eight passes offered defensible terrain; narrow paths through the mountain ravines often allowed people to pass.
translations.idiomatic: In fact none of the eight passes was truly defensible; footpaths through the ravines often allowed travelers to slip through.

sentences.zh: 自永昌迤邐而南為順甯，又南為普洱，其邊袤亙蓋二千餘里。

translations.literal: From Yongchang winding southward lay Shunning, and farther south Pu'er; the frontier stretched in all for more than two thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: South from Yongchang lay Shunning, and farther south Pu'er; the frontier belt ran for more than two thousand li.

sentences.zh: 永昌之盞達、隴川、猛卯、芒市、遮放，順甯之孟定、孟連、耿馬，普洱之車裏，數土司外，又有波龍、養子、野人、根都、佧佤、濮夷雜錯而居，非緬類，然多役於緬。

translations.literal: Besides the several chieftaincies of Zheda, Longchuan, Mengmao, Mangshi, and Zhefang in Yongchang; Mengding, Menglian, and Gengma in Shunning; and Cheli in Pu'er, Bolong, Yangzi, wild tribes, Gendu, Kawa, and Pu tribes lived intermingled. They were not Burmese, yet many were subject to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the major chieftaincies—Zheda, Longchuan, Mengmao, Mangshi, and Zhefang in Yongchang; Mengding, Menglian, and Gengma in Shunning; and Cheli in Pu'er—Bolong, Yangzi, wild tribes, Gendu, Kawa, and Pu peoples lived intermingled. Though not Burmese by origin, many were under Burmese control.

sentences.zh: 土司亦稍致餽遺，謂之「花馬禮」，由來久矣。

translations.literal: The chieftains also sent small gifts, called the "flower-and-horse tribute," a practice of long standing.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftains also sent modest gifts known as the "flower-and-horse tribute," a custom of long standing.

sentences.zh: 暨緬人內訌，禮遂廢。

translations.literal: When Burma fell into internal strife, the tribute ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When Burma fell into civil war, the custom lapsed.

sentences.zh: 甕藉牙父子欲復其舊，諸土司弗應，乃遣兵擾其地，而普洱獨先有事。

translations.literal: Yunxieya and his son wished to restore the old tribute, but the chieftains would not comply, so they sent troops to harass their lands; Pu'er was the first to see trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Yunxieya and his son sought to restore the old tribute, but the chieftains refused, so they sent troops to raid their territories—Pu'er was the first to come under attack.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，劉藻為雲南巡撫，額爾格圖為提督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Liu Zao became Yunnan grand coordinator and E'ergitu became provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1763), Liu Zao was appointed grand coordinator of Yunnan and E'ergitu provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，緬人先遣刀派先之兄刀派新自阿瓦還至孟連，徵索幣貨，又遣頭目卜布拉、木邦罕黑至耿馬責其禮。

translations.literal: That winter the Burmese first sent Dao Paixin, elder brother of Dao Paixian, back from Ava to Menglian to levy goods, and also sent the officer Bubula and Mohnyin's Han Hei to Gengma to demand tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Burmese sent Dao Paixin, elder brother of Dao Paixian, back from Ava to Menglian to extort goods, and dispatched officer Bubula and Mohnyin's Han Hei to Gengma to demand the customary tribute.

sentences.zh: 普洱之十三板納者，本車里土司地。

translations.literal: The Thirteen Ban Na of Pu'er had originally been Cheli chieftaincy territory.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'er's Thirteen Ban Na districts had originally belonged to the Cheli chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，鄂爾泰總督雲南，招降之，始割其地置府。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, when Ortai governed Yunnan, he induced them to submit and first carved out their lands to establish a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yongzheng (1729), Governor-General Ortai induced them to submit and carved out their territory to establish a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至是，緬人亦來索米。

translations.literal: By this time the Burmese also came to demand grain.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Burmese came demanding grain as well.

sentences.zh: 永順鎮總兵田允中、普洱鎮總兵劉德成、知府達成阿檄土司各率兵禦之，殺其頭目卜布拉、召罕標等，餘眾潰走。

translations.literal: Yongshun garrison commander Tian Yunzhong, Pu'er garrison commander Liu Decheng, and prefect Dacheng'a ordered the chieftains each to lead troops in defense. They killed the Burmese officers Bubula, Zhao Hanbiao, and others; the rest fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshun commander Tian Yunzhong, Pu'er commander Liu Decheng, and Prefect Dacheng'a ordered the chieftains to resist. They killed Burmese officers Bubula, Zhao Hanbiao, and others, and the rest fled in disarray.

sentences.zh: 孟艮本緬屬，距普洱千餘里，土司召孟容與弟召孟必不相能。

translations.literal: Menggen was originally a Burmese dependency more than a thousand li from Pu'er; chieftain Zhao Mengrong and his younger brother Zhao Mengbi were at odds.
translations.idiomatic: Menggen, a Burmese dependency more than a thousand li from Pu'er, was ruled by chieftain Zhao Mengrong, who was at odds with his younger brother Zhao Mengbi.

sentences.zh: 召孟必之子召散譖召孟容於緬，緬人執之，其子召丙走南掌。

translations.literal: Zhao Mengbi's son Zhao San slandered Zhao Mengrong to the Burmese, who seized him; Zhao Mengrong's son Zhao Bing fled to Lan Xang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Mengbi's son Zhao San denounced Zhao Mengrong to the Burmese, who arrested him; Mengrong's son Zhao Bing fled to Lan Xang.

sentences.zh: 尋入居於十三板納之孟遮，召散因令素領散聽、素領散撰、素領党阿烏弄等犯打樂，分侵九龍江橄欖壩，車里土司遁去，賊入據其城。

translations.literal: Soon he entered and settled at Mengzhe in the Thirteen Ban Na. Zhao San then ordered Sulingsanting, Sulingsanzuan, Suling Dang'a, and Wunong to attack Dale, while others raided the Olive Dam on the Nine-Dragon River. The Cheli chieftain fled; the rebels entered and seized his city.
translations.idiomatic: He soon established himself at Mengzhe in the Thirteen Ban Na. Zhao San sent Sulingsanting, Sulingsanzuan, Suling Dang'a, and Wunong against Dale while other columns raided the Olive Dam on the Nine-Dragon River. The Cheli chieftain fled, and the rebels occupied his city.

sentences.zh: 總督劉藻檄大理順甯營兵七千往剿，遊擊司邦直先進，為賊人所圍。

translations.literal: Governor-general Liu Zao ordered seven thousand troops from the Dali and Shunning garrisons to suppress them. Guerrilla officer Si Bangzhi advanced first and was surrounded by the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Liu Zao dispatched seven thousand men from the Dali and Shunning garrisons. Guerrilla officer Si Bangzhi led the advance and was surrounded by the rebels.

sentences.zh: 會參將劉明智至，夾攻破之，乘勝復車裏土司城。

translations.literal: When Brigadier Liu Mingzhi arrived, they attacked from both sides and broke the siege, then pressed the victory and recovered the Cheli chieftain's city.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadier Liu Mingzhi arrived, attacked from both flanks, and broke the siege; pressing their advantage, they recovered the Cheli chieftain's city.

sentences.zh: 進攻猛籠、猛歇、猛混、猛遮諸壘，連破之，然賊往往竄伏屯聚，未肯即退。

translations.literal: They advanced against the stockades at Menglong, Mengxie, Menghun, and Mengzhe, capturing them in succession, yet the rebels often hid in ambush and gathered in camps, refusing to withdraw at once.
translations.idiomatic: They stormed the stockades at Menglong, Mengxie, Menghun, and Mengzhe in succession, but the rebels kept slipping into ambush and regrouping, refusing to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 藻議益以曲尋、楚姚兵二千，未至，而參將何瓊詔、遊擊明浩等聞猛阿為賊所攻，遽率兵過滾弄江，束器械以行，不設備，入山遇賊，兵敗，詔論斬。

translations.literal: Liu Zao planned to add two thousand troops from Qujing and Chuyao, but before they arrived, Brigadiers He Qiongshao and guerrilla officer Ming Hao, hearing that Meng'a was under attack, hastily led troops across the Gunong River, bundling their weapons to march, taking no precautions. Entering the mountains they met the rebels, were defeated, and He Qiongshao was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zao planned to reinforce with two thousand men from Qujing and Chuyao, but before they arrived, Brigadier He Qiongshao and guerrilla officer Ming Hao, hearing Meng'a was under attack, rushed troops across the Gunong River with weapons bundled for easy carrying and no precautions. Ambushed in the hills, they were routed; He Qiongshao was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 時乾隆三十年也。

translations.literal: This was in the thirtieth year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: This took place in the thirtieth year of Qianlong (1765).

sentences.zh: 三十一年正月，詔大學士楊應琚自陝甘移督雲南，降劉藻湖北巡撫，藻自刎死。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-first year, an edict ordered Grand Secretary Yang Yingju to transfer from Shaan-Gan to govern Yunnan; Liu Zao was demoted to Hubei grand coordinator, and Liu Zao killed himself by cutting his throat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-first year (1766), Grand Secretary Yang Yingju was transferred from Shaan-Gan to govern Yunnan; Liu Zao was demoted to grand coordinator of Hubei and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 是月己亥，應琚至雲南，楚姚鎮總兵華封已平打樂，猛臘參將哈國興已平大猛養，合剿孟艮，召散遁，官軍得其城。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of that month Yang Yingju reached Yunnan. Chuyao garrison commander Hua Feng had already pacified Dale; Mengla brigadier Ha Guoxing had pacified Damengyang. They jointly suppressed Menggen; Zhao San fled and the government troops took his city.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of that month Yang Yingju reached Yunnan. Commander Hua Feng had already pacified Dale and Brigadier Ha Guoxing Damengyang; together they suppressed Menggen, Zhao San fled, and government forces seized his city.

sentences.zh: 而劉得成與提督達啟及參將孫爾桂攻整欠，亦克之。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Liu Decheng, together with Military Commissioner Da Qi and Brigadier Sun Ergui, attacked Zhengqian and also captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Liu Decheng, Military Commissioner Da Qi, and Brigadier Sun Ergui attacked Zhengqian and captured it as well.

sentences.zh: 普洱邊外悉平。

translations.literal: The entire Pu'er frontier was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The entire Pu'er frontier was pacified.

sentences.zh: 叭先捧者，車里土司之所屬，蓋微者也。

translations.literal: Ba Xianpeng was a subordinate of the Cheli chieftain, a man of humble rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ba Xianpeng was a minor subordinate of the Cheli chieftain.

sentences.zh: 顧與其妻咸以從軍自效，斬素領散撰於小猛侖，素領散聽亦為其妻殺死。

translations.literal: Yet he and his wife both joined the army to prove their worth: he beheaded Sulingsanzuan at Xiaomenglun, and his wife killed Sulingsanting.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he and his wife both took up arms in government service: he slew Sulingsanzuan at Xiaomenglun, and his wife killed Sulingsanting.

sentences.zh: 應琚乃請以召丙居孟艮，叭先捧居整欠，均授以指揮，使守其地。

translations.literal: Yang Yingju then requested that Zhao Bing reside at Menggen and Ba Xianpeng at Zhengqian, both being granted the rank of commander to guard those territories.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingju then petitioned to install Zhao Bing at Menggen and Ba Xianpeng at Zhengqian, each granted the rank of commander to hold the territory.

sentences.zh: 時提督李勳方至雲南，應琚令往孟艮、整欠正經界，定賦稅，附入版圖，為久遠計。

translations.literal: At that time Military Commissioner Li Xun had just arrived in Yunnan; Yang Yingju ordered him to go to Menggen and Zhengqian to fix boundaries, set taxes, and attach the lands to the imperial domain as a long-term measure.
translations.idiomatic: Military Commissioner Li Xun had just arrived in Yunnan; Yang Yingju ordered him to Menggen and Zhengqian to fix boundaries, set taxes, and incorporate the territories into the empire for good.

sentences.zh: 然召丙為人懦，不能安輯其人；

translations.literal: Yet Zhao Bing was a timid man and could not pacify his people;
translations.idiomatic: But Zhao Bing was timid and unable to pacify his people;

sentences.zh: 叭先捧不敢至整欠，退棲於猛搿。

translations.literal: Ba Xianpeng dared not go to Zhengqian and withdrew to dwell at Mengge.
translations.idiomatic: Ba Xianpeng dared not occupy Zhengqian and withdrew to Mengge.

sentences.zh: 四月，召散之黨召猛烈、召猛養以次被獲，其弟僧召龍亦自投首，惟召散逋逃未得。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Zhao San's partisans Zhao Menglie and Zhao Mengyang were captured in succession; his younger brother the monk Zhao Long also surrendered, but Zhao San remained at large.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Zhao San's followers Zhao Menglie and Zhao Mengyang were captured in turn; his brother the monk Zhao Long surrendered as well, but Zhao San himself remained at large.

sentences.zh: 應琚見夷人之易於摧殄也，遂上奏云：「臣兩月以來，訪問召散踪跡，逃往阿瓦，已飭土司繕寫緬文索取，不獻，當即興師問罪。

translations.literal: Seeing how easily the tribesmen could be crushed, Yang Yingju memorialized: "For two months your servant has traced Zhao San's movements; he has fled to Ava. I have already ordered the chieftains to draft a demand in Burmese script for his surrender. If he is not handed over, troops will immediately be raised to punish the offense.
translations.idiomatic: Concluding that the tribesmen were easily crushed, Yang Yingju memorialized: "For two months I have traced Zhao San's movements to Ava. I have ordered the chieftains to draft a demand in Burmese for his surrender. If he is not delivered, I shall immediately raise troops to punish Burma.

sentences.zh: 臣查緬甸連年內亂，篡奪相尋，實有可乘之會。

translations.literal: Your servant finds that Burma has suffered internal strife year after year, with usurpations following one another—there is truly an opportunity to be seized.
translations.idiomatic: Burma has suffered civil war year after year, with usurpations following one upon another—there is a real opening to exploit.

sentences.zh: 臣謹選人潛往阿瓦，將地方之廣狹，道路之險夷，詳悉繪圖，探明奏報。

translations.literal: Your servant has carefully chosen men to go secretly to Ava, to map in full detail the extent of the territory and the difficulty of the roads, investigate clearly, and report.
translations.idiomatic: I have sent agents secretly to Ava to map the territory's extent and the roads' difficulty in full detail and report back.

sentences.zh: 現已備可調之兵，佈置練習，密修戎器，以待進行。」

translations.literal: Troops available for deployment have now been prepared, arranged for drill, and weapons secretly repaired, awaiting the advance."
translations.idiomatic: Available troops are assembled, drilling, and arms are being repaired in secret, ready to march."

sentences.zh: 疏入，帝諭曰：「應琚久任邊疆，必不至輕率喜事。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the emperor instructed: "Yang Yingju has long served on the frontier and will surely not act rashly or court trouble.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor replied: "Yang Yingju has long served on the frontier and will surely not act rashly or court trouble.

sentences.zh: 如確有把握，自可乘時集事，剋日奏功。

translations.literal: If he is truly confident, he may seize the moment to gather forces and report victory on a set day.
translations.idiomatic: If he is truly confident, he may seize the moment and report victory on schedule.

sentences.zh: 倘勞師耗餉，稍致張惶，轉非慎重籌邊之道。

translations.literal: But if he exhausts the army and drains supplies and causes the slightest alarm, that would run counter to the prudent way of planning frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: But if he exhausts troops and treasury and causes alarm, that would be the opposite of prudent frontier planning.

sentences.zh: 務須熟計兼權，期於妥善，以定行止。」

translations.literal: He must weigh all factors carefully and aim for a sound decision before determining whether to proceed."
translations.idiomatic: He must weigh every factor carefully and decide soundly before acting."

sentences.zh: 是時諸將希應琚意，爭言內附。

translations.literal: At this time the generals, hoping to please Yang Yingju, vied in reporting submission to the empire.
translations.idiomatic: The generals, eager to please Yang Yingju, competed in reporting tribes willing to submit.

sentences.zh: 李勳以猛勇、猛散告，劉德成以猛龍、補哈告，華封以整賣、景線、景海告，率侈言夷地廣輪或二千里，或二千餘里，為邊外大都。

translations.literal: Li Xun reported on Mengyong and Mengsan; Liu Decheng on Menglong and Buha; Hua Feng on Zhengmai, Jingxian, and Jinghai—all exaggerating that the tribal lands measured two thousand li or more in circumference, calling them great frontier domains.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xun reported Mengyong and Mengsan; Liu Decheng Menglong and Buha; Hua Feng Zhengmai, Jingxian, and Jinghai—all exaggerating tribal domains as two thousand li or more across, great frontier territories.

sentences.zh: 應琚一一奏聞，以其頭目為千總、守備。

translations.literal: Yang Yingju reported each case to the throne and appointed their headmen as battalion commanders and garrison defenders.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingju reported each to the throne and appointed their headmen battalion commanders and garrison defenders.

sentences.zh: 緬甯通判富森言木邦人殺緬立土司罕黑，奉線甕團為主，原求內屬。

translations.literal: Dianning sub-prefect Fu Sen reported that Mohnyin people had killed the Burmese-installed chieftain Han Hei and set up Xian Wengtuan as leader, originally seeking to submit to the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Dianning sub-prefect Fu Sen reported that Mohnyin men had killed Burma's appointee Han Hei and set up Xian Wengtuan as leader, seeking to submit to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 永昌知府陳大呂亦言蠻暮土司被緬殘虐，久原歸誠，請發兵為助。

translations.literal: Yongchang prefect Chen Dalü also reported that the Manmu chieftain had long suffered Burmese cruelty and wished to submit, requesting troops to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang Prefect Chen Dalü reported that the Manmu chieftain had long suffered Burmese oppression and wished to submit, asking for troops to help.

sentences.zh: 應琚乃往駐永昌，而遣副將趙宏榜將永順、騰越兵三百餘人出鐵壁關屯新街，為蠻暮捍蔽。

translations.literal: Yang Yingju then went to station himself at Yongchang and dispatched Vice Commander Zhao Hongbang with more than three hundred Yongshun and Tengyue troops through Tiebi Pass to garrison Xinjie as a shield for Manmu.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingju moved his headquarters to Yongchang and sent Vice Commander Zhao Hongbang with over three hundred Yongshun and Tengyue troops through Tiebi Pass to garrison Xinjie and shield Manmu.

sentences.zh: 宏榜抵關，遇大呂所遣使，羈之，而自受蠻暮土司瑞團降。

translations.literal: Hongbang reached the pass, met an envoy sent by Dalü, detained him, and himself accepted the surrender of Manmu chieftain Ruituan.
translations.idiomatic: At the pass Hongbang met an envoy sent by Dalü, detained him, and accepted Manmu chieftain Ruituan's surrender himself.

sentences.zh: 大呂恚，訴應琚，應琚曲解之。

translations.literal: Dalü was angry and complained to Yang Yingju, who twisted the matter to excuse Hongbang.
translations.idiomatic: Dalü protested to Yang Yingju, who twisted the facts to shield Hongbang.

sentences.zh: 是時騰越知州陳廷獻招猛育、猛英、猛密，陳元震招戛鳩、允帽、結{此夕}，富森招佧佤，而宏榜又招孟養、乃壩竹、孟嶽十六寨諸夷，先後遣人來約降應琚又為文檄緬，侈言天朝有陸路兵三十萬，水路兵二十萬，陳於境以待速降，不然則進討。

translations.literal: At this time Tengyue magistrate Chen Tingxian recruited Mengyu, Mengying, and Mengmi; Chen Yuanzhen recruited Gajiu, Yunmao, and Jiexi; Fu Sen recruited the Kawa; and Hongbang also recruited Mengyang, Naibazhu, and the sixteen villages of Mengyue. Envoys came in succession to arrange surrender. Yang Yingju also issued a written proclamation to Burma, extravagantly claiming that the Celestial Dynasty had three hundred thousand land troops and two hundred thousand river troops arrayed on the border awaiting prompt surrender, otherwise it would advance in punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Tengyue Magistrate Chen Tingxian recruited Mengyu, Mengying, and Mengmi; Chen Yuanzhen Gajiu, Yunmao, and Jiexi; Fu Sen the Kawa; Hongbang Mengyang, Naibazhu, and sixteen Mengyue villages. Envoys arrived in succession to negotiate surrender. Yang Yingju also sent Burma a proclamation boasting of three hundred thousand land troops and two hundred thousand river troops on the border, demanding immediate surrender or invasion.

sentences.zh: 緬聞，乃大出兵。

translations.literal: When Burma heard this, it mobilized a great army.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, Burma mobilized a large army.

sentences.zh: 緬人素不養兵，有事則於所屬土司諸寨籍戶口多寡出夫，名曰「門戶兵」。

translations.literal: The Burmese did not ordinarily maintain standing troops; when there was business they levied men from subordinate chieftaincies and villages according to household numbers, called "household troops."
translations.idiomatic: Burmese did not keep standing armies; in wartime they levied men from subordinate chieftaincies by household count—the "household troops."

sentences.zh: 自甕藉牙據阿瓦，蓄勝兵萬人，一人給以餉四十兩，其餘派夫如故。

translations.literal: Since Yunxieya held Ava, he kept ten thousand elite troops, each paid forty taels of rations; the rest were levied as before.
translations.idiomatic: After Yunxieya seized Ava he maintained ten thousand elite troops, each paid forty taels; levies from the tribes continued as before.

sentences.zh: 每戰則以所派土司濮夷居前，勝兵督其後，而以馬兵為左右兩翼。

translations.literal: In each battle the levied chieftain and Pu tribesmen were placed in front, elite troops supervised from behind, and cavalry formed the left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: In battle levied chieftain and Pu levies formed the front line, elite troops supervised from behind, and cavalry the wings.

sentences.zh: 戰既合，兩翼分繞而進，往往以此取勝。

translations.literal: Once battle was joined, the wings would split and wheel inward, and victory was often won in this way.
translations.idiomatic: Once engaged, the wings would wheel inward around the enemy—a tactic that often won the day.

sentences.zh: 若自度不可勝，則急樹柵自固，而發連環槍砲蔽之。

translations.literal: If they judged they could not win, they quickly erected palisades to fortify themselves and fired chain-linked muskets and cannon to cover the work.
translations.idiomatic: If they judged defeat likely, they hastily threw up palisades and covered the work with volleys of musketry and cannon.

sentences.zh: 比煙開則柵木已立，入而拒守。

translations.literal: By the time the smoke cleared the palisades were already standing, and they entered to hold defense.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the smoke cleared the palisades stood complete, and they withdrew inside to defend.

sentences.zh: 其兵法如此。

translations.literal: Such was their military method.
translations.idiomatic: Such was their way of war.

sentences.zh: 九月，賊先以兵出落卓攻木邦，線甕團不能守，入居遮放，又以兵溯江而上，抵新街。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the rebels first sent troops from Luozhuo to attack Mohnyin; Xian Wengtuan could not hold and withdrew to Zhefang, while other troops moved upriver to Xinjie.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month rebels advanced from Luozhuo against Mohnyin; Xian Wengtuan could not hold and withdrew to Zhefang, while another column moved upriver to Xinjie.

sentences.zh: 宏榜相持兩日，勢不支，燒其器械輜重及傷病之兵，退回鐵壁關駐守，而蠻暮土司亦偕其母走入內地。

translations.literal: Hongbang held out two days but could not sustain the position; he burned his weapons, baggage, and wounded and sick troops, withdrew to garrison Tiebi Pass, and the Manmu chieftain fled inland with his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Hongbang held out two days, then burned weapons, baggage, and the wounded, retreated to Tiebi Pass, and the Manmu chieftain fled inland with his mother.

sentences.zh: 應琚憂甚，痰疾遽作，詔兩廣總督楊廷璋赴滇，代治應琚軍，並廉宏榜兵敗狀。

translations.literal: Yang Yingju was deeply worried and suddenly fell ill with phlegm disorder. An edict ordered Liang-Guang governor-general Yang Tingzhang to go to Yunnan to take over Yang Yingju's army and investigate Hongbang's defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply worried, Yang Yingju fell suddenly ill. The court ordered Liang-Guang Governor-General Yang Tingzhang to Yunnan to take command and investigate Hongbang's defeat.

sentences.zh: 又遣侍衛傅靈安挾御醫診應琚病，又命其子江蘇按察使重英、湖南寶慶知府重穀赴滇省視之。

translations.literal: The court also sent bodyguard Fu Ling'an with an imperial physician to treat Yang Yingju's illness, and ordered his sons—Jiangsu surveillance commissioner Chongying and Baoqing prefect of Hunan Chonggu—to go to Yunnan to visit him.
translations.idiomatic: The court also sent bodyguard Fu Ling'an with an imperial physician and ordered Yang's sons—Jiangsu surveillance commissioner Chongying and Hunan Baoding prefect Chonggu—to visit him in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 應琚所調兵一萬四千名將集，令永順鎮總兵烏爾登額駐宛頂進剿木邦，永北鎮總兵硃侖由鐵壁關進駐新街，而令提督李時升在杉木籠山居中調度。

translations.literal: The fourteen thousand troops Yang Yingju had mobilized were about to assemble; he ordered Yongshun commander Wu'erdenge to station at Wanding and advance against Mohnyin, Yongbei commander Zhu Lun to enter from Tiebi Pass and garrison Xinjie, and Military Commissioner Li Shisheng to coordinate from the center at Shanmulong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingju's fourteen thousand troops were assembling; he ordered Yongshun commander Wu'erdenge from Wanding against Mohnyin, Yongbei commander Zhu Lun through Tiebi Pass to Xinjie, and Military Commissioner Li Shisheng to coordinate from Shanmulong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 侖至楞木，突遇賊，戰四晝夜，賊退走，追擊之。

translations.literal: Zhu Lun reached Lengmu, suddenly met the rebels, fought four days and nights, the rebels retreated, and he pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Lun reached Lengmu, was ambushed, fought four days and nights, drove the rebels back, and pursued.

sentences.zh: 懵駁之弟卜坑及其舅莽聶渺節速詭求和，言原頂經吃咒水。

translations.literal: Mengbo's younger brother Bukeng and his maternal uncle Mang Nie Miao Jiesu falsely sued for peace, saying they wished to perform the oath of placing sutras on the head and drinking enchanted water.
translations.idiomatic: Mengbo's brother Bukeng and uncle Mang Nie Miao Jiesu feigned a peace offer, proposing the tribal oath of sutra crowns and enchanted water.

sentences.zh: 頂經者，以經加於首，呪水者，取水呪之，分與其眾飲，蓋夷人盟誓之禮也。

translations.literal: "Placing sutras on the head" meant placing scriptures on the crown; "enchanted water" meant taking water, chanting over it, and dividing it among the host to drink—the oath ritual of the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The "sutra crown" placed scriptures on the head; "enchanted water" was water over which spells were chanted and shared among the company—the tribal oath ritual.

sentences.zh: 議未定，賊已擁眾越神護、萬仞關，入掠盞達，圍遊擊馬拱垣於盞達江上，分兵入戶撒，遊擊邵應泌亦被圍。

translations.literal: Before terms were settled, the rebels had already crossed Shenhu and Wanyin passes in force, raided Zheda, besieged guerrilla officer Ma Gongyuan on the Zheda River, sent detachments into Husa, and guerrilla officer Shao Yingbi was also surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: Before terms were agreed, rebels had crossed Shenhu and Wanyin passes, raided Zheda, besieged guerrilla officer Ma Gongyuan on the Zheda River, sent columns into Husa, and surrounded guerrilla officer Shao Yingbi as well.

sentences.zh: 劉德成在幹崖有兵二千人，坐視不救。

translations.literal: Liu Decheng had two thousand men at Ganya but sat by without rescuing them.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Decheng had two thousand men at Ganya but did nothing to help.

sentences.zh: 時升因檄侖還守鐵壁。

translations.literal: Li Shisheng therefore ordered Zhu Lun back to defend Tiebi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shisheng ordered Zhu Lun back to defend Tiebi Pass.

sentences.zh: 又聞賊欲從庫弄河出關後，侖復引兵卻，駐守隴川。

translations.literal: Hearing further that the rebels intended to emerge behind the passes via the Kunong River, Zhu Lun again led his troops back and garrisoned Longchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the rebels might slip behind the passes via the Kunong River, Zhu Lun withdrew again to garrison Longchuan.

sentences.zh: 賊勢張甚，應琚數以檄促德成，始擊賊於銅壁關下，破之。

translations.literal: The rebel strength was formidable; Yang Yingju repeatedly urged Liu Decheng by dispatch, and only then did he attack the rebels below Tongbi Pass and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel strength was formidable; only after repeated orders from Yang Yingju did Liu Decheng attack below Tongbi Pass and defeat them.

sentences.zh: 賊自西而東趨隴川，德成亦由戶撒擊其後；

translations.literal: The rebels from west to east hastened toward Longchuan, and Decheng also from Husa struck their rear;
translations.idiomatic: The rebels marched east from the west toward Longchuan, while Liu Decheng struck their rear from Husa.

sentences.zh: 時升又檄烏爾登額帥宛頂兵至邦中山，以助聲勢；

translations.literal: Li Shisheng again dispatched Wu'erdenge to lead Wanding troops to Bangzhong Mountain to bolster the show of force;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shisheng also ordered Wu'erdenge to lead Wanding troops to Bangzhong Mountain to strengthen the army's presence.

sentences.zh: 於是軍威稍振。

translations.literal: Thereupon military prestige was somewhat restored.
translations.idiomatic: The army's morale improved somewhat.

sentences.zh: 賊人見大兵之集也，復來乞降，侖以報應琚，命許之。

translations.literal: The rebels, seeing the great army gathering, again came to sue for surrender; Zhu Lun reported this to Yang Yingju, who ordered that they be granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing imperial forces massing, the rebels again sued for surrender; Zhu Lun reported to Yang Yingju, who ordered acceptance.

sentences.zh: 賊伺我軍懈，遂走犯猛卯。

translations.literal: The rebels watched for slackness in our army, then fled to attack Mengmao.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels waited until our troops relaxed their guard, then broke away to attack Mengmao.

sentences.zh: 猛卯與木邦親，木邦之降，猛卯實左右焉。

translations.literal: Mengmao was close to Mohnyin; in Mohnyin's surrender, Mengmao had in fact swayed the outcome.
translations.idiomatic: Mengmao was allied with Mohnyin, and had in fact been decisive in Mohnyin's submission.

sentences.zh: 賊怨，故蹂躪之。

translations.literal: The rebels resented this and therefore ravaged it.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels resented this and ravaged the district.

sentences.zh: 時三十二年正月丙寅朔也。

translations.literal: It was the first day of the first month of cyclical day Bingyin in the thirty-second year.
translations.idiomatic: It was New Year's Day of the thirty-second year.

sentences.zh: 副將哈國興帥兵二千五百人趨猛卯，比至，見賊勢盛，乃入城與土司堅守。

translations.literal: Deputy general Ha Guoxing led twenty-five hundred men toward Mengmao; upon arrival, seeing the rebel force strong, he entered the city and held fast with the native chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy General Ha Guoxing marched twenty-five hundred men toward Mengmao; finding the rebels too strong, he entered the city and held it with the local chieftain.

sentences.zh: 賊攻城，緣梯而上，城上矢砲交發，賊不敢近。

translations.literal: The rebels assaulted the city, climbing ladders to ascend; arrows and cannon fired from the walls in succession, and the rebels dared not approach.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels assaulted the walls on ladders, but volleys of arrows and cannon from the ramparts kept them at bay.

sentences.zh: 圍八日，癸酉，副將陳廷蛟、遊擊雅爾姜阿各以兵至，城中出合擊之，賊大潰；

translations.literal: After eight days of siege, on cyclical day Guiyou, deputy generals Chen Tingjiao and guerrilla officer Ya'erjiang'a each arrived with troops; forces from within the city sallied forth and joined in the attack, and the rebels routed in great disorder;
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth day of the siege, Deputy Generals Chen Tingjiao and Guerrilla Officer Ya'erjiang'a arrived with reinforcements; the garrison sallied out to join the attack and the rebels broke in rout.

sentences.zh: 而烏爾登額久不至，故賊得浮猛卯江而逸。

translations.literal: But Wu'erdenge long failed to arrive, so the rebels were able to cross the Mengmao River by raft and escape.
translations.idiomatic: Wu'erdenge never arrived, however, and the rebels crossed the Mengmao River by raft and escaped.

sentences.zh: 硃侖乃造浮橋過宿養渡，由景陽、暮董偕烏爾登額進剿木邦。

translations.literal: Zhu Lun then built a pontoon bridge to cross Suyang Ford, and via Jingyang and Muda joined Wu'erdenge in advancing against Mohnyin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Lun built a pontoon bridge at Suyang Ford and, marching through Jingyang and Muda, joined Wu'erdenge in an advance on Mohnyin.

sentences.zh: 是月丁丑，楊廷璋至軍，見賊未易遽平，遂奏言應琚病已痊，臣當歸粵。

translations.literal: That month on cyclical day Dingchou, Yang Tingzhang reached the army; seeing the rebels would not be quickly subdued, he memorialized that Yang Yingju's illness had healed and that he himself should return to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yang Tingzhang reached the army; seeing the rebels would not be quickly crushed, he reported that Yang Yingju had recovered and asked to return to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 帝召廷璋還京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor summoned Yang Tingzhang back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor recalled Yang Tingzhang to the capital.

sentences.zh: 時賊入關侵擾，應琚皆不以聞，僅言硃侖殺賊幾萬人，賊震懼，乞降，欲以新街、蠻暮與之；

translations.literal: Meanwhile, as rebels entered the passes to raid and harass, Yang Yingju reported none of it, saying only that Zhu Lun had killed tens of thousands of rebels, that the rebels were terrified and sought surrender, and that he wished to yield Xinjie and Manmu to them;
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile rebels were raiding inside the passes, but Yang Yingju reported none of it—only that Zhu Lun had killed tens of thousands of rebels, that they were terrified and suing for peace, and that he wished to cede Xinjie and Manmu.

sentences.zh: 而時升亦言猛卯之捷，誅其大頭目播定鮓、皮魯布。

translations.literal: Li Shisheng also reported victory at Mengmao and the execution of their chief leaders Bodianzha and Pilubu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shisheng also reported victory at Mengmao and the execution of rebel chiefs Bodianzha and Pilubu.

sentences.zh: 奏入，帝視應琚所進地圖，用藍筆分中外界，而猛卯、隴川均在藍線內，疑之，以為如果殲賊萬餘及大頭目，賊當遁走不暇，何以朱崙輾轉退卻，賊敢蔓延內地土司之境？

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the Emperor looked at the map Yang Yingju had submitted, marked the border between inner and outer territory in blue ink, and saw that both Mengmao and Longchuan lay within the blue line; he grew suspicious, reasoning that if tens of thousands of rebels and their chiefs had truly been destroyed, the rebels ought to have fled in disarray—how could Zhu Lun have kept falling back while the rebels dared spread into the territory of inland native chieftaincies?
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor examined Yang Yingju's map, traced the inner-outer border in blue, and noticed that Mengmao and Longchuan both lay inside the line. He grew suspicious: if tens of thousands of rebels and their chiefs had truly been destroyed, they should have fled in panic—how could Zhu Lun keep retreating while rebels spread into inland chieftaincy territory?

sentences.zh: 降旨駁詰。

translations.literal: An edict was issued rebuking and questioning him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued an edict rebuking and questioning him.

sentences.zh: 而傅靈安先奉詔廉訪軍事，具言趙宏榜棄新街，硃侖退守隴川，及李時升未經臨敵情事，與帝所駁詰者悉合。

translations.literal: Fu Ling'an had already been ordered to investigate military affairs on an inspection tour and detailed how Zhao Hongbang had abandoned Xinjie, Zhu Lun had withdrawn to defend Longchuan, and Li Shisheng had never personally faced the enemy—exactly matching the Emperor's rebukes.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ling'an, already on an imperial inspection of military affairs, reported that Zhao Hongbang had abandoned Xinjie, Zhu Lun had fallen back to Longchuan, and Li Shisheng had never personally faced the enemy—precisely matching the emperor's rebukes.

sentences.zh: 應琚復劾劉德成、烏爾登額逗留貽誤。

translations.literal: Yang Yingju further impeached Liu Decheng and Wu'erdenge for tarrying and causing delay.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingju further impeached Liu Decheng and Wu'erdenge for dawdling and causing delay.

sentences.zh: 於是逮李時升、硃侖、劉德成、烏爾登額、趙宏榜，而晉楊甯為提督。

translations.literal: Thereupon Li Shisheng, Zhu Lun, Liu Decheng, Wu'erdenge, and Zhao Hongbang were arrested, and Yang Ning was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shisheng, Zhu Lun, Liu Decheng, Wu'erdenge, and Zhao Hongbang were arrested, and Yang Ning was promoted to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 且以應琚欺罔乖謬不能任事，乃召明瑞於伊犁，以將軍督軍雲南，遣額爾景額為參贊大臣，徙巡撫湯聘於貴州，以鄂寧代之。

translations.literal: Moreover, deeming Yang Yingju deceitful, perverse, and unfit for office, the court summoned Ming Rui from Ili to serve as general supervising the Yunnan army, dispatched Erjing'e as consultative minister, transferred governor Tang Pin to Guizhou, and replaced him with E'ning.
translations.idiomatic: Judging Yang Yingju deceitful, perverse, and unfit for office, the court summoned Ming Rui from Ili to command the Yunnan campaign as general, sent Erjing'e as consultative minister, transferred Governor Tang Pin to Guizhou, and replaced him with E'ning.

sentences.zh: 上年冬，緬人已據整賣、景線，召散遂率以攻孟艮，召丙懼，出奔，賊延入打樂，思茅同知黑光以聞。

translations.literal: The previous winter the Burmese had already taken Zhengmai and Jingxian; Zhaosan then led them to attack Menggen; Zhaobing was afraid and fled; the rebels pushed into Dale; Simao sub-prefect magistrate Hei Guang reported it.
translations.idiomatic: The previous winter the Burmese had seized Zhengmai and Jingxian; Zhaosan led them against Menggen; Zhaobing fled in fear; the rebels pushed into Dale; Simao Magistrate Hei Guang reported the incursion.

sentences.zh: 時湯聘未聞上命，楊重英方至自江蘇，乃偕赴普洱，奏言總兵華封、甯珠安坐普洱，失剿禦，請革職治罪。

translations.literal: Tang Pin had not yet received the imperial order; Yang Chongying had just arrived from Jiangsu; they went together to Pu'er and memorialized that generals Hua Feng and Ning Zhu sat idle at Pu'er, failing to suppress and repel the enemy, and should be dismissed and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Pin had not yet received imperial orders when Yang Chongying arrived from Jiangsu; together they went to Pu'er and reported that Generals Hua Feng and Ning Zhu had sat idle there, failing to suppress the enemy, and should be dismissed and punished.

sentences.zh: 奏入，華封、寧珠與遊擊權恕、司邦直，都司甘其卓皆被逮，調開化鎮總兵書敏總統進剿。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, Hua Feng, Ning Zhu, guerrilla officer Quan Shu, Sima Bangzhi, and battalion commander Gan Qizhuo were all arrested; Kaifeng commander Shu Min was transferred to take overall command of the advance.
translations.idiomatic: On receipt of the memorial, Hua Feng, Ning Zhu, Guerrilla Officer Quan Shu, Sima Bangzhi, and Battalion Commander Gan Qizhuo were arrested; Kaifeng Commander Shu Min was assigned overall command of the advance.

sentences.zh: 頃之，鄂寧亦至普洱，奏言：「上年九龍江外兵馬以瘴死者不可勝數，官弁夫役死亦大半。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward E'ning also reached Pu'er and memorialized: "Last year beyond the Jiulong River, troops who died of miasma were beyond counting, and officers, soldiers, and laborers who died also amounted to more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward E'ning reached Pu'er and reported: "Last year beyond the Jiulong River, troops who died of miasma were beyond counting, and more than half the officers, soldiers, and laborers also perished.

sentences.zh: 此時正盛瘴發生，湯聘乃稱嚴飭將卒，克日進剿，懷詐塞責，實無誠款。」

translations.literal: At this time miasma was at its peak, yet Tang Pin claimed he was strictly ordering officers and soldiers and would advance on a set day—he was deceitful in shirking responsibility and truly had no sincere intent."
translations.idiomatic: Miasma was then at its worst, yet Tang Pin claimed he was tightening discipline and would advance on a set date—deceitful evasion of duty, with no sincere intent."

sentences.zh: 奏入，湯聘以革職逮治。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, Tang Pin was dismissed from office and arrested for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When the report arrived, Tang Pin was dismissed and arrested.

sentences.zh: 應琚見前所招撫土司復陰附緬，其土司頭目夷人千百為群，皆蕩析離居，而緬賊時出沒為患，邊事日棘。

translations.literal: Yang Yingju saw that the native chieftaincies previously won over again secretly attached themselves to Burma; their chieftains, heads, and tribesmen clustered in groups of hundreds and thousands, all scattered and displaced; and Burmese rebels constantly appeared and vanished causing trouble—the border situation grew more urgent daily.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingju saw the chieftaincies he had pacified secretly reattach themselves to Burma; chieftains and tribesmen clustered in hundreds and thousands, scattered and displaced, while Burmese raiders constantly appeared and vanished—the border crisis worsened by the day.

sentences.zh: 鄂甯復奏應琚貪功啟釁，為硃侖等諱飾，又不令湯聘、傅靈安與聞邊務，及隱沒遊擊班第、守備江紀陣亡各狀。

translations.literal: E'ning again memorialized that Yang Yingju was greedy for merit and provoked conflict, covered up for Zhu Lun and others, would not let Tang Pin and Fu Ling'an know border affairs, and concealed reports of guerrilla officer Bandi and garrison commander Jiang Ji's deaths in battle.
translations.idiomatic: E'ning again reported that Yang Yingju had provoked war for glory, covered up for Zhu Lun and others, kept Tang Pin and Fu Ling'an out of border affairs, and concealed the battlefield deaths of Guerrilla Officer Bandi and Garrison Commander Jiang Ji.

sentences.zh: 應琚懼，乃奏請是秋大舉征緬，調兵五萬，五路並進，兼約暹羅夾攻。

translations.literal: Yang Yingju grew afraid and memorialized requesting a major autumn campaign against Burma, mobilizing fifty thousand troops in five columns advancing simultaneously, and also arranging for Siam to attack from both sides.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing for himself, Yang Yingju proposed a major autumn campaign against Burma: fifty thousand troops in five columns, with Siam attacking from the flank.

sentences.zh: 帝下其議，廷臣皆斥之。

translations.literal: The Emperor submitted his proposal for discussion, and court ministers all rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor circulated the proposal; court ministers unanimously rejected it.

sentences.zh: 詔逮應琚至京，賜死。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yang Yingju brought to the capital and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yang Yingju brought to the capital and executed.

sentences.zh: 四月，明瑞至永昌。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Ming Rui reached Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Ming Rui reached Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 時楊寧壁軍木邦，餉道為賊所斷，潰退滿河。

translations.literal: At the time Yang Ning had garrisoned the army at Mohnyin; the supply route was cut by rebels; they broke and retreated, filling the river.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Ning was then encamped at Mohnyin; rebels cut his supply line and his troops broke, retreating in such numbers that they filled the river.

sentences.zh: 永北鎮總兵索柱及烏爾登額亡其印信。

translations.literal: Yongbei commander Suozhu and Wu'erdenge lost their official seals.
translations.idiomatic: Yongbei Commander Suozhu and Wu'erdenge lost their official seals.

sentences.zh: 明瑞以聞，楊寧亦被逮，調譚五格為提督，詔派八旗兵三千、四川兵八千、貴州兵一萬、雲南兵四千，赴邊進討。

translations.literal: Ming Rui reported this; Yang Ning was also arrested; Tan Wuge was transferred as military commissioner; an edict assigned three thousand Banner troops, eight thousand Sichuan troops, ten thousand Guizhou troops, and four thousand Yunnan troops to go to the border for the advance.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui reported the disaster; Yang Ning was arrested; Tan Wuge was appointed military commissioner; and an edict dispatched three thousand Banner troops, eight thousand from Sichuan, ten thousand from Guizhou, and four thousand from Yunnan to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 綠營馬匹皆本營預備，惟八旗兵三千人，每兵例需馬三匹，合官員所用，計馬幾萬匹。

translations.literal: Green Standard horses were all pre-arranged by their units; only the three thousand Banner soldiers required three horses per man by regulation, plus those for officers—totaling tens of thousands of horses.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard units supplied their own horses; the three thousand Banner troops alone required three horses per man by regulation, plus mounts for officers—tens of thousands in all.

sentences.zh: 明瑞議撥廣西馬一千、廣東馬八百、四川馬五千八百、貴州馬六千、湖南馬二千，每兵裹兩月糧，計六斗，馱以一馬。

translations.literal: Ming Rui proposed allotting one thousand Guangxi horses, eight hundred Guangdong horses, five thousand eight hundred Sichuan horses, six thousand Guizhou horses, and two thousand Hunan horses; each soldier carried two months' grain, six dou in total, borne on one horse.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui proposed drawing one thousand horses from Guangxi, eight hundred from Guangdong, five thousand eight hundred from Sichuan, six thousand from Guizhou, and two thousand from Hunan; each soldier would carry two months' rations—six dou total—on one pack animal.

sentences.zh: 馬、驢少，購牛代之。

translations.literal: Horses and donkeys being scarce, cattle were purchased as substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: With horses and donkeys scarce, cattle were purchased instead.

sentences.zh: 糧不足，可殺牛以抵。

translations.literal: When grain ran short, cattle could be slaughtered to make up the difference.
translations.idiomatic: When rations ran short, the cattle could be slaughtered to make up the shortfall.

sentences.zh: 共用驢、馬、牛八百餘。

translations.literal: In all, more than eight hundred donkeys, horses, and cattle were used.
translations.idiomatic: More than eight hundred donkeys, horses, and cattle were employed in all.

sentences.zh: 其糧於大理、鶴慶、蒙化三府撥六萬石，又於永昌、順甯買三萬石。

translations.literal: Grain was allotted sixty thousand shi from Dali, Heqing, and Menghua prefectures, and thirty thousand shi purchased at Yongchang and Shunning.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty thousand shi of grain were levied from Dali, Heqing, and Menghua, and thirty thousand shi purchased at Yongchang and Shunning.

sentences.zh: 兵行之道，自宛頂、木邦進者為正兵，明瑞身統之。

translations.literal: Of the routes for the army's march, that advancing from Wanding and Mohnyin was the main force, which Ming Rui personally commanded.
translations.idiomatic: Of the routes of march, the main column advancing from Wanding and Mohnyin was under Ming Rui's personal command.

sentences.zh: 烏爾登額、譚五格則由猛密分進。

translations.literal: Wu'erdenge and Tan Wuge were to advance separately via Mengmi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu'erdenge and Tan Wuge were to advance separately through Mengmi.

sentences.zh: 至新街，水路，時方暑雨，難造舟，宜削木柹沿江流下，疑賊以牽其勢。

translations.literal: At Xinjie, the water route—at that time in summer rains, boats were hard to build; it was advisable to carve log rafts and float them downriver to mislead the rebels and draw off their strength.
translations.idiomatic: At Xinjie, the water route: summer rains made boat-building impractical; Ming Rui proposed carving log rafts to float downstream, feigning a river advance to draw off rebel strength.

sentences.zh: 奏入，帝嘉之，悉從其議。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the Emperor praised it and approved all his proposals.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised the plan and approved it in full.

sentences.zh: 九月，諸路兵皆至永昌，馬、牛亦集。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, troops from all routes reached Yongchang, and horses and cattle were assembled.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month all columns reached Yongchang, with horses and cattle assembled.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，明瑞率軍啟行。

translations.literal: On cyclical day Jiayin, Ming Rui led the army to set out.
translations.idiomatic: On cyclical day Jiayin, Ming Rui led the army out.

sentences.zh: 值大雨，潞江舟少，以次待渡，而溝路陰仄，輜重壅塞於道，軍士立雨中竟夕。

translations.literal: Heavy rain fell; boats on the Lu River were few and men waited their turn to cross; the track was narrow and shaded, baggage clogged the road, and soldiers stood in the rain all night.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain fell; boats on the Lu River were scarce and troops waited in turn to cross; the narrow track jammed with baggage, and soldiers stood in the rain all night.

sentences.zh: 十月甲申，抵帕兒，帝復遣參贊大臣珠魯訥至軍，而參贊大臣額爾景額、楚姚鎮總兵國柱相繼病歿。

translations.literal: On the tenth month, cyclical day Jiashen, they reached Pa'er; the Emperor again sent consultative minister Zhulun'e to the army, while consultative minister Erjing'e and Chuyao commander Guozhu died of illness in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on cyclical day Jiashen, they reached Pa'er; the emperor sent Consultative Minister Zhulun'e to join the army, while Consultative Minister Erjing'e and Chuyao Commander Guozhu died of illness in succession.

sentences.zh: 賊偵知，毀津渡橋樑，且伐大樹撲之。

translations.literal: The rebels learned of this, destroyed ferry crossings, bridges, and beams, and also felled great trees to throw across them.
translations.idiomatic: Learning of the advance, the rebels destroyed ferries, bridges, and trestles and felled great trees to block the way.

sentences.zh: 又雨多道壞，軍行遲滯，明瑞乃選銳兵一半，帥以先驅。

translations.literal: Rain again ruined the roads and the army's march slowed; Ming Rui then selected half his crack troops and led them as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Rain ruined the roads and the march slowed; Ming Rui selected half his best troops and pushed ahead as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 領隊大臣觀音保由孟穀出木邦之右。

translations.literal: Column commander Guanyinbao emerged from Menggu to the right of Mohnyin.
translations.idiomatic: Column Commander Guanyinbao marched out of Menggu to Mohnyin's right flank.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，抵木邦城。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, cyclical day Bingxu, they reached Mohnyin city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on cyclical day Bingxu, they reached Mohnyin.

sentences.zh: 賊先挾夷民以去，獲其糧貯，留珠魯訥以兵四千守之。

translations.literal: The rebels had first taken the tribal people away; they seized the rebels' grain stores and left Zhulun'e with four thousand men to garrison the place.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had already driven the tribespeople away; the Qing forces seized their grain stores and left Zhulun'e with four thousand men to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 進至錫箔江，江寬，架橋以渡。

translations.literal: Advancing to the Xibo River—the river was wide—they built a bridge to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to the wide Xibo River, they bridged it and crossed.

sentences.zh: 行四日，至天生橋，橋南有賊砦相偪。

translations.literal: After marching four days they reached Tiansheng Bridge; south of the bridge a rebel fort pressed close.
translations.idiomatic: Four days' march brought them to Tiansheng Bridge, where a rebel fort pressed close on the south.

sentences.zh: 會商人馬子團言橋之東三十里水淺可涉，且岸頗平，乃以兵繞出其後。

translations.literal: A merchant, Ma Zituan, said that thirty li east of the bridge the water was shallow and fordable and the bank fairly level; troops were therefore sent to circle around behind them.
translations.idiomatic: A merchant named Ma Zituan reported that thirty li east of the bridge the water was shallow and the bank level; Ming Rui sent troops to outflank the fort.

sentences.zh: 賊復棄砦去，遂進至蠻結。

translations.literal: The rebels again abandoned the fort and withdrew; they then advanced to Manjie.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels abandoned the fort and withdrew; the army pressed on to Manjie.

sentences.zh: 賊依山立十六柵以待。

translations.literal: The rebels set up sixteen palisades along the mountain to await them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels built sixteen mountain palisades to receive them.

sentences.zh: 明瑞抵柵下，親冒槍砲督兵進攻。

translations.literal: Ming Rui reached the foot of the palisades and personally braved musket and cannon fire to direct the assault.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui reached the palisades and personally braved musket and cannon fire to direct the assault.

sentences.zh: 觀音保麾眾先據山左。

translations.literal: Guanyinbao commanded his men to seize the left of the mountain first.
translations.idiomatic: Guanyinbao led his men to seize the mountain's left flank first.

sentences.zh: 哈國興等三路登山，俯薄之，呼而逼其壘。

translations.literal: Ha Guoxing and others climbed the mountain in three columns, pressed down from above, shouted, and closed on their ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Guoxing and others climbed in three columns, pressed down from above, shouting as they closed on the ramparts.

sentences.zh: 貴州步兵王連睨柵左有積木，躤之以登，躍入柵內，八十餘人繼之。

translations.literal: Guizhou infantryman Wang Lian noticed piled logs to the left of the palisade, stepped on them to climb, leaped inside the palisade, and more than eighty men followed.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou infantryman Wang Lian spotted a pile of logs to the palisade's left, climbed them, leaped inside, and more than eighty men followed.

sentences.zh: 賊恇亂，莫知所措，多被殺，遂破其一柵。

translations.literal: The rebels panicked, not knowing what to do; many were killed, and one palisade was taken.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels panicked; many were killed and one palisade fell.

sentences.zh: 旋復攻破三柵，而十二柵之賊悉乘夜潛遁。

translations.literal: Soon three more palisades were stormed, while the rebels in the remaining twelve all slipped away under cover of night.
translations.idiomatic: Three more palisades were stormed; the defenders of the remaining twelve slipped away under cover of night.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，晉封明瑞誠嘉毅勇公，以恩澤侯與其弟奎林，特擢王連為遊擊，餘俱交部敘功。

translations.literal: When news of victory arrived, Ming Rui was promoted and enfeoffed as Duke of Sincere, Commendable, Resolute, and Valiant; the title of Marquis of Grace and Favor was given to his brother Kuilin; Wang Lian was specially promoted to guerrilla officer; the rest were referred to the ministry for recording of merit.
translations.idiomatic: On news of victory, Ming Rui was enfeoffed as Duke of Sincere, Commendable, Resolute, and Valiant; his brother Kuilin received the title Marquis of Grace and Favor; Wang Lian was specially promoted to guerrilla officer; the rest were referred to the ministry for merit awards.

sentences.zh: 然夷境益峭險，其草率綠竹、王芻之屬，馬乏食，多致斃，而牛行遲滯，箠之以登，死者尤眾。

translations.literal: Yet the tribal territory grew ever steeper and more perilous; coarse grasses, green bamboo, Imperata and similar plants left horses short of fodder and many died; cattle marched slowly and were whipped up the slopes—the dead were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: But the tribal country grew ever steeper; coarse grasses and bamboo left horses without fodder and many died; cattle moved slowly and were whipped up the slopes—casualties among them were especially heavy.

sentences.zh: 賊燒其村寨，斂積貯而窖埋之，掠食無所得，軍糧垂竭。

translations.literal: The rebels burned their villages, gathered stores and buried them in pits; raiding for food yielded nothing; army provisions were nearly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels burned their villages, gathered stores, and buried them in pits; foraging yielded nothing and army rations nearly ran out.

sentences.zh: 進至象孔，迷失道。

translations.literal: Advancing to Xiangkong, they lost the way.
translations.idiomatic: At Xiangkong they lost their way.

sentences.zh: 明瑞度不能至阿瓦，約烏爾登額等軍由猛密入。

translations.literal: Ming Rui judged he could not reach Ava and arranged for Wu'erdenge's army and others to enter via Mengmi.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui judged he could not reach Ava and arranged for Wu'erdenge's column to enter through Mengmi.

sentences.zh: 其地近孟籠，有緬屯糧，且可與猛密軍相合，乃議向孟籠，果大獲糧；

translations.literal: That region was near Menglong, where Burmese had stored grain, and he could link up with the Mengmi army; they therefore planned to head for Menglong and indeed obtained grain in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The region near Menglong held Burmese grain stores and offered a junction with the Mengmi column; they turned toward Menglong and obtained grain in abundance.

sentences.zh: 而烏爾登額等趨猛密，出虎踞關，聞老官屯有賊，意輕之，先率眾往攻。

translations.literal: Wu'erdenge and the others hastened toward Mengmi, passed Huju Pass, heard there were rebels at Laoguantun, took them lightly, and led their force to attack first.
translations.idiomatic: Wu'erdenge's column pressed toward Mengmi, passed Huju Pass, heard of rebels at Laoguantun, underestimated them, and attacked first.

sentences.zh: 賊固守，弗能下，軍士多傷亡，陝西興漢鎮總兵王玉廷亦中槍卒。

translations.literal: The rebels held firm and could not be reduced; many soldiers were killed or wounded; Shaanxi Xinghan commander Wang Yuting was also struck by a musket ball and died.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held firm; many soldiers fell; Shaanxi Xinghan Commander Wang Yuting was shot and killed.

sentences.zh: 珠魯訥守木邦，有夷數十人來降，疑其偽，悉誅之，而遣索柱等往錫箔江設台站，以通明瑞軍信息。

translations.literal: Zhulun'e garrisoned Mohnyin; several dozen tribesmen came to surrender; suspecting deceit, he executed them all; and sent Suozhu and others to the Xibo River to establish relay stations so as to communicate with Ming Rui's army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhulun'e held Mohnyin; several dozen tribesmen surrendered, but suspecting treachery he executed them all; he sent Suozhu and others to the Xibo River to establish relay stations linking him to Ming Rui.

sentences.zh: 索柱等至蒲卡，聞賊至，以兵少，退守錫箔，賊躡之，戰歿。

translations.literal: Suozhu and the others reached Puka; hearing rebels were coming and their force being small, they withdrew to defend Xibo; the rebels pursued, and they died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Suozhu reached Puka; hearing rebels approach and finding his force too small, he fell back to Xibo; the rebels pursued and killed him in battle.

sentences.zh: 賊遂附木邦城下，絕營南水道，糧運之從宛頂來者，賊又截之，軍士皆饑渴，火藥亦盡，賊審其困，佯為好語求和，珠魯訥不得已，遣楊重英及守備王呈瑞往報，賊人留之，且誘軍士出汲，斷其後，皆不得還。

translations.literal: The rebels then closed on Mohnyin city, cut off the waterways south of the camp, and intercepted grain convoys coming from Wanding; the soldiers were all hungry and thirsty, gunpowder was also exhausted; the rebels, seeing their distress, feigned friendly words to sue for peace; Zhulun'e had no choice but to send Yang Chongying and garrison commander Wang Chengrui to report; the rebels detained them and also lured soldiers out to draw water, cut off their retreat—all were unable to return.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels closed on Mohnyin, cut the waterways south of the camp, and intercepted grain convoys from Wanding; the garrison starved and thirsted, gunpowder ran out; the rebels, seeing their distress, feigned a peace offer; Zhulun'e sent Yang Chongying and Garrison Commander Wang Chengrui to respond; the rebels detained them and lured soldiers out for water, cutting off their retreat—none returned.

sentences.zh: 三十三年正月，益兵攻城。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-third year, they increased troops to assault the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-third year the rebels reinforced and assaulted the city.

sentences.zh: 丁未夜，兵亂，珠魯訥自剄死，普洱鎮總兵胡大猷亦歿。

translations.literal: On the night of cyclical day Dingwei, the army mutinied; Zhulun'e cut his own throat and died; Pu'er commander Hu Dayou also perished.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of cyclical day Dingwei the garrison mutinied; Zhulun'e cut his throat and died; Pu'er Commander Hu Dayou also perished.

sentences.zh: 賊之圍木邦也，珠魯訥屢促鄂寧救援，而永昌兵盡行，無可調發。

translations.literal: When the rebels besieged Mohnyin, Zhulun'e repeatedly urged E'ning to send relief, but all Yongchang troops had already marched out and none could be mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: During the siege of Mohnyin, Zhulun'e repeatedly begged E'ning for relief, but every Yongchang soldier was already in the field and none could be spared.

sentences.zh: 已而促之急，始令遊擊袁夢麟等率駐宛頂兵三百人以往，遇賊，皆不知所之。

translations.literal: Only when pressed urgently did he finally order guerrilla officer Yuan Menglin and others to lead three hundred men garrisoned at Wanding to go; they met rebels and all disappeared without trace.
translations.idiomatic: Only under urgent pressure did E'ning finally send Guerrilla Officer Yuan Menglin with three hundred men from Wanding; they met rebels and vanished without trace.

sentences.zh: 知府陳元震、郭鵬翀持參贊印先三日逸出，鄂寧捕得之，磔死。

translations.literal: Prefects Chen Yuanzhen and Guo Pengchong fled three days earlier carrying the consultative minister's seal; E'ning captured them and had them dismembered and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects Chen Yuanzhen and Guo Pengchong had fled three days earlier with the consultative minister's seal; E'ning captured them and had them dismembered.

sentences.zh: 明瑞既就糧孟籠，諜知烏爾登額未至猛密，而諜者報大山土司瓦喇遣弟羅旺育來迎，且率其子阿隴從軍；

translations.literal: Ming Rui having obtained provisions at Menglong, spies learned Wu'erdenge had not reached Mengmi; spies also reported that Dashan chieftain Wala sent his younger brother Luowangyu to welcome them and led his son Along to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: After Ming Rui obtained provisions at Menglong, scouts learned Wu'erdenge had not reached Mengmi; others reported that Dashan Chieftain Wala sent his brother Luowangyu to welcome the army and led his son Along to join it.

sentences.zh: 而緬自去冬象孔改道後，獲官軍病卒，知糧盡，不向阿瓦，即悉眾躡官軍後。

translations.literal: Since last winter, after the army changed route at Xiangkong, the Burmese had captured sick soldiers from the imperial army, learned provisions were exhausted and they were not heading for Ava, and immediately sent their full force to pursue the imperial army from behind.
translations.idiomatic: Since the previous winter, when the army changed route at Xiangkong, the Burmese had captured sick Qing soldiers, learned rations were exhausted and Ava was no longer the objective, and sent their full force in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 官軍且戰且行，每日先以一軍拒敵，即以軍退至數里外成列，待軍至，則成列者復迎戰。

translations.literal: The imperial army fought as it marched; each day one unit first held off the enemy, then that unit withdrew several li and formed ranks; when the main body arrived, those in ranks again met the enemy in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing army fought as it marched: each day one unit held the rear, withdrew several li and formed line; when the main body arrived, the line turned to fight again.

sentences.zh: 明瑞及觀音保、哈國興更番殿后，步步為營，每日行不三十里。

translations.literal: Ming Rui, Guanyinbao, and Ha Guoxing took turns covering the rear, advancing camp by camp, marching no more than thirty li per day.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui, Guanyinbao, and Ha Guoxing rotated as rear guard, advancing camp by camp, covering no more than thirty li a day.

sentences.zh: 正月丙午，至蠻化，營於山巔，賊即營山半。

translations.literal: On the first month, cyclical day Bingwu, they reached Manhua and encamped on the mountain summit; the rebels immediately encamped halfway up the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On cyclical day Bingwu in the first month they reached Manhua and encamped on the summit; the rebels camped halfway up the slope.

sentences.zh: 明瑞曰：「賊輕我甚矣，不一痛創之不可！」

translations.literal: Ming Rui said: "The rebels think very lightly of us; unless we inflict a sharp blow, it will not do!"
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui said: "The rebels despise us utterly; unless we strike them hard, this cannot go on!"

sentences.zh: 時賊識官軍軍號，每晨吹波倫者三而起行，賊亦起。

translations.literal: At that time the rebels knew the imperial army's signals; each morning when the signal trumpet was blown three times to rouse the march, the rebels also rose.
translations.idiomatic: By then the rebels knew the army's signals; each morning when the trumpet sounded three times to rouse the march, they rose as well.

sentences.zh: 次日五鼓復吹波倫三，乃盡出營伏箐中以待。

translations.literal: The next day at the fifth watch the signal trumpet was again blown three times; they then all left camp and lay in ambush in the ravines to wait.
translations.idiomatic: The next morning at the fifth watch the trumpet sounded three times again; the Qing troops left camp and lay in ambush in the ravines.

sentences.zh: 賊聞波倫聲爭上山來追，萬槍突出，四面兜擊，賊潰墜者趾頂相藉，坑谷皆滿，殺四千餘人。

translations.literal: Hearing the trumpet signal, the rebels scrambled up the mountain in pursuit; ten thousand muskets sprang forth, attacked from all sides; the routed rebels fell piled foot atop crown, ravines and valleys all filled—more than four thousand were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the trumpet, the rebels scrambled up in pursuit; ten thousand muskets erupted from ambush on every side; routed rebels fell piled foot to crown, filling ravines and valleys—more than four thousand were killed.

sentences.zh: 明瑞休軍蠻化數日，取所得牛馬犒士。

translations.literal: Ming Rui rested the army at Manhua several days and took the cattle and horses obtained to reward the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui rested the army at Manhua for several days and rewarded the troops with captured cattle and horses.

sentences.zh: 又自蠻化至邦邁、虎布、蠻移、小天生橋、僮子壩，大小數十戰，永順鎮總兵李全歿於陣。

translations.literal: From Manhua to Bangmai, Hubu, Manyi, Xiao Tiansheng Bridge, and Tongzi Dam they fought several dozen engagements large and small; Yongshun commander Li Quan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: From Manhua through Bangmai, Hubu, Manyi, Xiao Tiansheng Bridge, and Tongzi Dam they fought dozens of engagements; Yongshun Commander Li Quan fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 又稍稍聞木邦失守。

translations.literal: Word also gradually came that Mohnyin had fallen.
translations.idiomatic: Word gradually reached them that Mohnyin had fallen.

sentences.zh: 明瑞恥是役之無功也，二月己未，至猛育，距宛頂糧台二百里，賊蝟集數萬。

translations.literal: Ming Rui was shamed that the campaign had yielded no success; on the second month, cyclical day Jiwei, they reached Mengyu, two hundred li from the Wanding grain depot; rebels swarmed in tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Ashamed that the campaign had achieved nothing, Ming Rui reached Mengyu in the second month on cyclical day Jiwei—two hundred li from the Wanding grain depot—with tens of thousands of rebels swarming around him.

sentences.zh: 明瑞乃令軍士乘夜出，而自與領隊大臣及巴圖魯侍衛數十人率親兵數百斷其後。

translations.literal: Ming Rui then ordered the soldiers to break out under cover of night, while he himself with column commanders and several dozen Bannerman guards led several hundred personal troops to cover the rear.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui ordered the main body to break out by night while he himself, with column commanders and several dozen Banner guards, led several hundred personal troops to hold the rear.

sentences.zh: 及晨，血戰萬賊中，無不一當百。

translations.literal: By dawn they fought bloody battle amid ten thousand rebels; each man was worth a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn they were fighting in a sea of rebels; each man fought as if worth a hundred.

sentences.zh: 俄，明瑞槍傷於肋，呼從者取水至，飲水少許而絕。

translations.literal: Soon Ming Rui was wounded by musket fire in the ribs; he called for an attendant to bring water; after drinking a little, he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon a musket ball struck Ming Rui in the ribs; he called for water, drank a little, and died.

sentences.zh: 觀音保、紮拉豐阿皆戰死，死者凡千餘人。

translations.literal: Guanyinbao and Zhala Feng'a both died in battle; the dead numbered more than a thousand in all.
translations.idiomatic: Guanyinbao and Zhala Feng'a both fell in battle; the dead numbered more than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 是夕也，星隕如雨，餘軍先後潰歸宛頂。

translations.literal: That same evening, stars fell like rain; the remaining troops broke one after another and fled back to Wanding.
translations.idiomatic: That night stars fell like rain, and the surviving troops broke in succession and fled back to Wanding.

sentences.zh: 明瑞自蠻結破賊後，懸軍深入。

translations.literal: After Ming Rui broke the rebels at Manjie, he advanced deep with his army isolated from support.
translations.idiomatic: After Ming Rui routed the rebels at Manjie, he pushed deep into enemy country with his army cut off from relief.

sentences.zh: 帝久不得報，命戶部尚書果毅公阿裏袞以參贊大臣赴邊援應。

translations.literal: The emperor, long without reports, ordered Household Minister and Duke Guoyi Arigun to go to the frontier as consultative minister to reinforce and respond.
translations.idiomatic: Long without word from the front, the emperor ordered Household Minister and Duke Guoyi Arigun to the border as consultative minister to reinforce the army.

sentences.zh: 又聞木邦被困，命明瑞旋軍，而敕烏爾登額撤老官屯之圍，往援木邦。

translations.literal: Learning also that Mohnyin was besieged, he ordered Ming Rui to turn back, and instructed Wu'erdenge to lift the siege of Laoguantun and go to Mohnyin's aid.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Mohnyin was besieged, he ordered Ming Rui to withdraw and instructed Wu'erdenge to abandon the siege of Laoguantun and march to Mohnyin's relief.

sentences.zh: 賊覺，扼馬膊子嶺，烏爾登額幾不得出；

translations.literal: The rebels discovered this and blocked Mapozi Pass; Wu'erdenge nearly could not get out;
translations.idiomatic: The rebels discovered the move and blocked Mapozi Pass; Wu'erdenge was nearly trapped;

sentences.zh: 而自旱塔抵猛密，木邦有袤徑頗近，烏爾登額以馬盡糧乏，紆道入虎踞關，經猛卯，至宛頂，復駐軍。

translations.literal: But from Hanta to Mengmi there was a fairly direct route through Mohnyin; because horses were exhausted and provisions spent, Wu'erdenge took a roundabout route through Huju Pass, passed Mengmao, reached Wanding, and encamped again.
translations.idiomatic: From Hanta to Mengmi a more direct route ran through Mohnyin, but with horses spent and grain gone Wu'erdenge took a detour through Huju Pass, passed Mengmao, returned to Wanding, and encamped again.

sentences.zh: 明日而明瑞陣亡之信已至，鄂甯劾其有心玩誤，詔逮至京磔之，並誅譚五格於市，而厚恤明瑞。
