translations.idiomatic: After defeating the Burmese, the people made Zhao ruler, moved the capital to Bangkok, pacified the realm, and prosperity grew.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，鄭昭遣使朗丕彩悉呢、霞握撫突等入貢，奏稱暹羅自遭緬亂，復土報仇，國人以詔裔無人，推昭為長，遵例貢獻。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year, Zheng Zhao dispatched envoys Lang Picaini, Xia Wofutu, and others in tribute, memorializing that since Siam suffered Burmese turmoil, recovered its territory and avenged the wrong, and the people, finding no survivor of the Zhao lineage, acclaimed Zhao as leader and followed precedent in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-six Zheng Zhao sent envoys Lang Picaini and Xia Wofutu in tribute, reporting Burma's invasion, recovery of the realm, and Zhao's elevation for lack of Zhao-lineage heirs.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉之，宴使臣於山高水長。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended this and feasted the envoys at "Lofty Mountain, Long Waters."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised them and feasted the envoys at the Lofty Mountain, Long Waters pavilion.

sentences.zh: 所貢方物，收象一頭、犀角一石，餘物准在廣東出售，與他貨皆免稅。

translations.literal: Of tribute products, one elephant and one shi of rhinoceros horn were accepted; remaining items were permitted for sale in Guangdong, and all other goods were tax-exempt.
translations.idiomatic: One elephant and one shi of rhinoceros horn were retained; other tribute goods could be sold tax-free in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 特賜國長蟒緞、珍物如舊制。

translations.literal: Specially granted the national leader python satin and treasure items as in the old system.
translations.idiomatic: The leader received python satin and treasures as under the old system.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，昭卒，子鄭華嗣立。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year, Zhao died; his son Zheng Hua succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-seven Zhao died; his son Zheng Hua succeeded.

sentences.zh: 華亦材武，屢破緬，緬酋孟隕不能敵，東徙居蠻得勒。

translations.literal: Hua was also capable in martial affairs, repeatedly defeated Burma; Burmese chief Mengyun could not resist and moved east to dwell at Mandele.
translations.idiomatic: Hua was martial too, repeatedly defeating Burma; Mengyun could not stand against him and moved east to Mandele.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，華遣使入貢御前方物：龍涎香、金鋼鑽、沉香、冰片、犀角、孔雀尾、翠皮、西洋氈、西洋紅布、象牙、樟腦、降真香、白膠香、大楓子、烏木、白豆蔻、檀甘密皮、桂皮、螣黃，外馴象二。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, Hua dispatched envoys presenting imperial gifts: ambergris, diamonds, agarwood, borneol, rhinoceros horn, peacock tail feathers, kingfisher feather trimming, Western felt, Western red cloth, ivory, camphor, eaglewood, gum benzoin, large areca nuts, ebony, white cardamom, sandalwood and kamani bark, cinnamon bark, and orpiment—besides two trained elephants.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-one Hua sent envoys with imperial gifts: ambergris, diamonds, agarwood, borneol, rhinoceros horn, peacock feathers, kingfisher trim, Western felt and red cloth, ivory, camphor, eaglewood, benzoin, areca nuts, ebony, white cardamom, sandalwood and kamani bark, cinnamon, and orpiment—plus two trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 中宮前無象，物半之。

translations.literal: Before the empress there had been no elephant; items were halved.
translations.idiomatic: For the empress, who had never received an elephant, half the goods were sent.

sentences.zh: 並請封。

translations.literal: Also requesting investiture.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested investiture.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，封鄭華為暹羅國王，如康熙十二年之例。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, Zheng Hua was enfeoffed as King of Siam, following the precedent of the twelfth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, Zheng Hua was enfeoffed King of Siam, following the Kangxi 12 precedent.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「我國誕膺天命，統御萬方，聲教覃敷，遐邇率服。

translations.literal: The patent read: "Our state received Heaven's mandate at birth, governing all regions; our voice and teaching spread widely, near and far all submitting.
translations.idiomatic: The patent read: "Our state received Heaven's mandate, governing all regions; our voice and teaching spread far, and near and distant lands alike submitted.

sentences.zh: 暹羅國地隔重洋，向修職貢，自遭緬亂，人民土地悉就摧殘，實堪憫惻！

translations.literal: Siam lies across heavy seas, long maintaining tribute duties; since suffering Burmese turmoil, its people and land have been utterly devastated—truly pitiable!
translations.idiomatic: Siam lies across heavy seas and long paid tribute; since Burma's invasion its people and land have been devastated—truly pitiable!

sentences.zh: 前攝國事長鄭昭，當舉國被兵之後，收合餘燼，保有一方，不廢朝貢。

translations.literal: The former regent Zheng Zhao, after the whole country had been at war, gathered the remaining embers, kept one region intact, and did not cease court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Former regent Zheng Zhao, after the whole country had been ravaged by war, gathered what remained, held one region together, and never ceased tribute.

sentences.zh: 其嗣鄭華，克承父志，遣使遠來，具見忱悃。

translations.literal: His heir Zheng Hua, able to carry on his father's purpose, sent envoys from afar—fully showing sincere devotion.
translations.idiomatic: His heir Zheng Hua carried on his father's purpose, sent envoys from afar, and showed sincere devotion.

sentences.zh: 朕撫綏方夏，罔有內外，悉主悉臣，設暹羅舊王后嗣尚存，自當擇其嫡派，俾守世封。

translations.literal: I pacify and cherish the regions of Xia, without distinction of inner and outer—all lords, all subjects; had surviving heirs of Siam's old royal house remained, the legitimate line would naturally have been chosen to keep the hereditary enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: I pacify all regions without distinction of inner and outer—all lords, all subjects; had heirs of Siam's old royal house survived, the legitimate line would naturally have kept the hereditary seal.

sentences.zh: 茲聞舊裔遭亂淪亡，鄭氏攝國長事，既閱再世，用能保其土宇，輯和人民，闔國臣庶，共所推戴。

translations.literal: Now I hear the old line perished in turmoil; the Zheng house has held regency for two generations, able to keep its territory and settle its people—the whole country's officials and commoners jointly acclaim them.
translations.idiomatic: Now I hear the old line perished in turmoil; the Zheng house has governed for two generations, kept its territory, settled its people, and won the whole country's acclaim.

sentences.zh: 用是特頒朝命，封爾鄭華為暹羅國王，錫之誥印，尚其恪修職事，慎守籓封，撫輯番民，勿替前業，以副朕懷柔海邦、興廢繼絕之至意。」

translations.literal: Therefore I specially issue court command, enfeoff you Zheng Hua as King of Siam, grant patent and seal; earnestly perform your duties, carefully keep your feudatory, pacify and settle your people, do not abandon prior accomplishments, to fulfill my utmost intent of gentle cherishing of overseas states and raising what was ruined and continuing what was broken off."
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I invest you, Zheng Hua, as King of Siam and grant patent and seal; perform your duties faithfully, guard your feudatory, pacify your people, and do not abandon what your house has built—to fulfill my intent of cherishing distant realms and restoring what was lost."

sentences.zh: 是年，粵督穆騰額奏定暹羅正副貢船各一免稅，餘船按貨征榷，以杜奸商取巧。

translations.literal: That year, Guangdong governor Muteng'e memorialized fixing one principal and one deputy tribute ship each tax-exempt, other ships taxed on goods, to block merchants' evasions.
translations.idiomatic: That year Governor Muteng'e fixed one principal and one deputy tribute ship as tax-exempt and taxed other ships by cargo, to stop merchant evasions.

sentences.zh: 先是緬甸憚國威內附，後屢為暹羅所敗，五十三年，來貢，乞諭暹羅罷兵。

translations.literal: Previously Burma feared our national might and submitted; later repeatedly defeated by Siam—in the fifty-third year they came in tribute, begging that Siam be instructed to cease warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Burma had once submitted out of fear of our might but was repeatedly defeated by Siam; in year fifty-three it sent tribute, begging that Siam be told to cease fighting.

sentences.zh: 五十四年正月，帝賜鄭華敕曰：「朕惟自古帝王功隆丕冒，典重懷柔，凡航海梯山重譯而至者，無不悉歸涵育，咸被恩膏。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifty-fourth year, the Emperor granted Zheng Hua an edict: "I consider that since ancient times emperors' merit reaches vast heaven, their canons emphasize gentle cherishing; all who come by sea or mountain crossing many translations—all are nurtured and all receive grace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year fifty-four the Emperor granted Zheng Hua an edict: "Since ancient times emperors' merit has reached vast heaven and their canon has emphasized gentle rule; all who come by sea or mountain, through many tongues—all are nurtured and showered with grace.

sentences.zh: 爾暹羅國王鄭華遠處海隅，因受封籓職，遣使帕使滑裏遜通亞排那赤突等恭齎方物，入貢謝恩，具徵忱悃。

translations.literal: You, King of Siam Zheng Hua, dwell far at the sea's edge; having received feudatory investiture, you dispatch envoys Pa Shi Huali Xuntong, Yapainachi Tu, and others reverently bearing local products in tribute to express gratitude, fully showing sincere devotion.
translations.idiomatic: You, King of Siam Zheng Hua, dwell far at the sea's edge; having received feudatory investiture, you sent envoys Pa Shi Huali Xuntong, Yapainachi Tu, and others with tribute to express gratitude—fully showing sincere devotion.

sentences.zh: 朕念爾國與緬甸接壤，往者懵駁、贅角牙相繼為暴，侵陵爾國，興師構怨，匪爾之由。

translations.literal: I consider your country borders Burma; formerly Mengbo and Zhuajiaoya successively acted violently, encroaching on your country and raising armies to foster resentment—not your fault.
translations.idiomatic: I know your country borders Burma; formerly Mengbo and Zhuajiaoya successively acted violently, invaded your realm, and raised armies—the fault was not yours.

sentences.zh: 今緬甸孟雲新掌國事，悔罪輸誠，籥求內附，已於其使臣回國時諭令孟雲與爾國重修和好，毋尋干戈。

translations.literal: Now Burma's Mengyun newly holds state affairs, repents and submits sincerity, earnestly seeks submission; when his envoys returned I already instructed Mengyun to renew good relations with your country and not seek warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Now Burma's Mengyun has newly taken power, repented, and sought submission; when his envoys returned I already told Mengyun to renew friendship with your country and lay down arms.

sentences.zh: 爾亦宜盡釋前嫌，永弭兵釁，同作籓封，共承恩眷。

translations.literal: You also should fully release prior grudges, forever cease military conflict, equally serve as feudatories, and jointly receive grace.
translations.idiomatic: You too should release old grievances, forever cease fighting, serve equally as feudatories, and share in imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 茲特賜國王絲、幣等物，尚其祇受嘉命，倍篤忠忱，仰副眷懷，長膺天寵。

translations.literal: Now I specially grant the king silk, cloth, and other items; reverently receive this splendid command, doubly devote loyal sincerity, respond to cherishing grace, and long receive Heaven's favor.
translations.idiomatic: I now grant you silk, cloth, and other gifts; receive this command reverently, redouble your loyalty, answer my grace, and long enjoy Heaven's favor.

sentences.zh: 欽哉！」

translations.literal: Revere this!"
translations.idiomatic: Revere this!"

sentences.zh: 明年，鄭華咨稱：「乾隆三十一年，烏肚構兵，國破君亡。

translations.literal: The next year, Zheng Hua consulted: "In the thirty-first year of Qianlong, Wudu raised arms; the state was destroyed and the lord perished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Zheng Hua petitioned: "In Qianlong 31, Wudu attacked; the state was destroyed and the king killed.

sentences.zh: 其父鄭昭光復故物，十僅五六。

translations.literal: His father Zheng Zhao recovered the old possessions—only five or six tenths.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zheng Zhao recovered the old realm—but only five or six tenths of it.

sentences.zh: 舊有丹荖氏、麻叨、塗懷三城，仍被佔據，懇諭令烏肚歸還，以復國土之舊。」

translations.literal: The three cities Danlaoshi, Madou, and Tuhuai formerly held were still occupied; humbly requesting instruction that Wudu return them to restore the old national territory."
translations.idiomatic: The three cities Danlaoshi, Madou, and Tuhuai were still occupied; he humbly asked that Wudu be ordered to return them and restore the old borders."

sentences.zh: 粵督郭世勳以聞。

translations.literal: Guangdong governor Guo Shixun reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Guo Shixun reported this.

sentences.zh: 帝念暹羅所稱之「烏肚番」即緬甸。

translations.literal: The Emperor noted that "Wudu barbarians" as Siam called them were Burma.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor noted that the "Wudu barbarians" Siam named were the Burmese.

sentences.zh: 前緬甸與暹羅詔氏構兵，系已故緬酋懵駁，非今王孟雲之事。

translations.literal: Formerly Burma and Siam's Zhao house were at war—this was the deceased Burmese chief Mengbo, not today's king Mengyun.
translations.idiomatic: Burma's earlier war with Siam's Zhao house was the work of the late chief Mengbo, not today's king Mengyun.

sentences.zh: 丹荖氏等三城，亦系詔氏在國時被緬甸侵佔，非鄭氏國土。

translations.literal: The three cities Danlaoshi and others were also territory seized by Burma when the Zhao house still ruled—not Zheng house territory.
translations.idiomatic: The three cities Danlaoshi and the rest had been seized from the Zhao house while it still ruled—not from Zheng territory.

sentences.zh: 相安年久，自應各守疆界。

translations.literal: Having lived at peace for many years, each should naturally keep their borders.
translations.idiomatic: They had lived at peace for years; each side should keep its own borders.

sentences.zh: 今暹羅已經易世，暹羅又系異姓繼立為王，更不當爭論詔氏舊失疆土。

translations.literal: Now Siam has already changed dynasties; Siam also has a different surname succeeding as king—still less should they dispute the Zhao house's old lost territory.
translations.idiomatic: Siam had already changed dynasties; with a different house on the throne, it was still less fitting to dispute the Zhao house's old lost lands.

sentences.zh: 命軍機大臣代世勳擬檄諭止之。

translations.literal: Ordered grand councilors to draft a proclamation on Shixun's behalf instructing them to desist.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the Grand Council to draft a proclamation for Shixun instructing them to desist.

sentences.zh: 是年，入貢，因慶祝萬壽，加進壽燭、沉香、紫膠香、冰片、燕窩、犀角、象牙、通大海、哆囉呢九種，帝亦加賜國王御筆「福」字。

translations.literal: That year, presenting tribute, because of birthday celebration, additionally sent nine kinds: longevity candles, aloeswood, purple lac resin, borneol, bird's nest, rhinoceros horn, ivory, tongdahai, and doro ni cloth; the Emperor also additionally granted the king an imperial brush character "Fortune."
translations.idiomatic: That year, for the birthday celebration, tribute added nine items: longevity candles, aloeswood, purple lac, borneol, bird's nest, rhinoceros horn, ivory, tongdahai, and doro ni cloth; the Emperor also granted the king an imperial brush character for "Fortune."

sentences.zh: 六十年，暹羅破柬埔寨，取阿可耳及破丁篷二地。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, Siam defeated Cambodia and took the two regions Akor and Potaim.
translations.idiomatic: In year sixty Siam defeated Cambodia and took Akor and Potaim.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，暹羅遣使進太上皇帝、皇帝漢、番字金葉表文並方物。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, Siam dispatched envoys presenting gold-leaf memorials in Chinese and foreign script to the Retired Emperor and the Emperor, along with local products.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 Siam sent envoys with gold-leaf memorials in Chinese and foreign script to the Retired Emperor and the Emperor, along with local products.

sentences.zh: 正月，命使臣與甯壽宮千叟宴，賜正使聖制千叟宴詩一章。

translations.literal: In the first month, ordered envoys to attend the Qian Shou Feast at Ningshou Palace; granted the chief envoy one stanza of imperially composed Qian Shou Feast poetry.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month the envoys joined the Thousand Elders Feast at Ningshou Palace; the chief envoy received an imperial poem composed for that feast.

sentences.zh: 二年，遣使賀歸政及登極，貢龍涎香、冰片等二十四種。

translations.literal: In the second year, dispatched envoys to congratulate on abdication and accession, presenting twenty-four kinds including ambergris and borneol.
translations.idiomatic: In year two envoys congratulated the abdication and accession, presenting twenty-four kinds including ambergris and borneol.

sentences.zh: 帝奉太上皇帝命賜鄭華敕曰：「九服承風，建極著會歸之義，三加錫命，樂天廣怙冒之仁。

translations.literal: The Emperor, following the Retired Emperor's command, granted Zheng Hua an edict: "The nine domains receive our influence; establishing the pole shows the principle of gathering in; thrice adding bestowed commands, rejoicing in Heaven's broad cherishing grace.
translations.idiomatic: At the Retired Emperor's command the Emperor granted Zheng Hua an edict: "The nine domains receive our influence; establishing the pole shows the principle of gathering all under heaven; thrice adding bestowed commands shows Heaven's broad cherishing grace.

sentences.zh: 舊典維昭，新綸用沛。

translations.literal: Old canons remain bright; new silks flow abundantly.
translations.idiomatic: Old canons remain bright; new silks flow abundantly.

sentences.zh: 爾暹羅國王鄭華屢供王會，久列籓封。

translations.literal: You, King of Siam Zheng Hua, have repeatedly supplied the royal assembly, long listed among feudatories.
translations.idiomatic: You, King of Siam Zheng Hua, have long attended court assemblies and stood among the feudatories.

sentences.zh: 茲於嘉慶二年，復遣使臣奉表入貢，鑒其忱悃，允荷褒揚。

translations.literal: Now in Jiaqing 2 you again dispatch envoys bearing memorials in tribute; discerning your sincere devotion, praise is duly deserved.
translations.idiomatic: Now in Jiaqing 2 you again sent envoys with tribute; seeing your sincere devotion, praise is well deserved.

sentences.zh: 至以天朝疊慶重熙，倍呈方物，具見輸誠效順，弗懈益虔。

translations.literal: As for presenting doubled local products for the celestial court's layered celebrations—fully showing submission and obedience, never slackening but growing more reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting doubled gifts for the court's layered celebrations shows submission and obedience, never slackening but growing more reverent.

sentences.zh: 國家厚往薄來，字小柔遠，自有定制。

translations.literal: The state gives generously and receives lightly, cherishing the small and gentling the distant—there are fixed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The state gives generously and receives lightly, cherishing small states and gentling the distant—by fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 第念爾國僻處海陬，梯航遠涉，其所備物若從擯卻，勞費轉多，特飭收受，加賜文綺等物。

translations.literal: But considering your country lies remote at the sea's corner, climbing mountains and sailing ships from afar—if what you prepared were rejected, your labor and expense would only increase; I specially order acceptance and additionally grant patterned silks and other items.
translations.idiomatic: But your country lies remote at the sea's edge and your envoys come from afar; rejecting what you prepared would only increase your labor and expense—so I order acceptance and grant patterned silks and other gifts.

sentences.zh: 嗣後止宜照常進呈一分，以示體恤。

translations.literal: Hereafter you should present only the usual single set, to show considerate care.
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter you should present only the usual single set, as a mark of considerate care.

sentences.zh: 王其祇承眷顧，益懋忠純，永膺蕃庶之恩，長隸職方之長。

translations.literal: King, reverently receive this grace, further strive in pure loyalty, forever receive favor for your peoples, and long remain within the roster of official domains.
translations.idiomatic: King, receive this grace reverently, strive further in pure loyalty, forever enjoy favor for your people, and long remain within the imperial roster.

sentences.zh: 欽哉！」

translations.literal: Revere this!"
translations.idiomatic: Revere this!"

sentences.zh: 三年，召暹羅使臣宴重華宮。

translations.literal: In the third year, summoned Siam's envoys to feast at the Chonghua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In year three Siam's envoys were summoned to feast at the Chonghua Palace.

sentences.zh: 五年，國王遣使齎祭文、儀物，詣高宗純皇帝前進香，並獻方物，廣東巡撫遵旨令使臣毋庸來京，悉將方物齎回。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the king dispatched envoys bearing sacrificial text and ritual objects to offer incense before the Gaozong Chun Emperor, also presenting local products; the Guangdong provincial governor, following instructions, ordered envoys need not come to the capital—all local products to be brought back.
translations.idiomatic: In year five the king sent envoys with sacrificial text and ritual objects to offer incense before the Gaozong Chun Emperor and present local products; the Guangdong governor, following orders, told them not to come to the capital and to take all gifts back.

sentences.zh: 六年，副貢使怕窩們孫哖哆呵叭病歿廣東，?地方官妥為照料，賞銀三百兩，先行回國。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, deputy tribute envoy Pa Womensun Nian Duo Habba died of illness in Guangdong; local officials were ordered to see to arrangements properly; three hundred taels of silver were granted; he was sent home first.
translations.idiomatic: In year six deputy envoy Pa Womensun Nian Duo Habba died of illness in Guangdong; local officials were ordered to see to his remains properly, three hundred taels were granted, and his body was sent home.

sentences.zh: 十年，暹羅貢表，言與緬甸戰獲捷，有詔和解之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Siam's tribute memorial stated victory in war with Burma; an edict ordered reconciliation.
translations.idiomatic: In year ten Siam's tribute memorial reported victory over Burma; an edict ordered reconciliation.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月，帝諭鄭華：「不許違例用中國人駕船，代運貨物往來，以免奸商隱匿，致啟訟端。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twelfth year, the Emperor instructed Zheng Hua: "It is not permitted in violation of regulations to use Chinese to captain ships and transport goods back and forth on your behalf, lest unscrupulous merchants conceal themselves and provoke lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year twelve the Emperor told Zheng Hua: "You may not violate regulations by using Chinese captains to transport goods on your behalf, lest unscrupulous merchants hide behind the arrangement and provoke lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 倘有違背，奸商治罪，國王亦難辭其咎。

translations.literal: If there is violation, unscrupulous merchants will be punished, and the king also cannot escape blame.
translations.idiomatic: If this is violated, the merchants will be punished—and the king cannot escape blame either.

sentences.zh: 特申禁令，以嚴逾越之防。

translations.literal: This prohibition is specially declared to strictly guard against overstepping bounds.
translations.idiomatic: This prohibition is declared to guard strictly against overstepping bounds.

sentences.zh: 爾國王其凜遵毋忽！」

translations.literal: King, reverently obey—do not neglect this!"
translations.idiomatic: King, obey reverently—do not neglect this!"

sentences.zh: 十四年，遣使祝嘏，加賞正副使筵宴重華宮。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, dispatched envoys to offer birthday blessings; additionally rewarded the chief and deputy envoys with feasts at the Chonghua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In year fourteen envoys were sent with birthday felicitations, and the chief and deputy envoys were additionally granted feasts at the Chonghua Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋，鄭華卒，世子鄭佛繼立。

translations.literal: In autumn, Zheng Hua died; the heir Zheng Fo succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Zheng Hua died and was succeeded by his heir Zheng Fo.

sentences.zh: 遣使入貢請封，遭風沉失貢物九種，帝諭不必補進。

translations.literal: Dispatched envoys in tribute seeking investiture; struck by wind, nine kinds of tribute goods were lost; the Emperor instructed that replacement need not be presented.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to present tribute and seek investiture; a storm sank nine kinds of tribute goods, and the Emperor said they need not be replaced.

sentences.zh: 十五年，封鄭佛為暹羅王，給誥命、駝鈕鍍金銀印，交使齎回。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Zheng Fo was enfeoffed as King of Siam; patent and camel-knob gilded silver seal were granted and handed to envoys to carry back.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifteen Zheng Fo was invested King of Siam and given patent and a gilded silver seal with a camel-shaped knob, to be carried home by his envoys.

sentences.zh: 十八年冬，總督蔣攸銛奏暹羅正貢船在洋焚毀，僅副貢船抵粵，副使唧拔察哪丕汶知突有疾，聞正貢船遭焚，驚懼，益劇，不能即赴都。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighteenth year, Governor-General Jiang Youqian reported that Siam's principal tribute ship burned at sea; only the deputy tribute ship reached Guangdong; deputy envoy Jibachana Biwen Zhitu was ill—hearing the principal ship had burned, he was alarmed and frightened, his illness worsened, and he could not promptly go to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year eighteen Governor-General Jiang Youqian reported that Siam's principal tribute ship had burned at sea and only the deputy ship reached Guangdong. Deputy envoy Jibachana Biwen Zhitu was already ill; when he heard the principal ship had burned he grew alarmed, his condition worsened, and he could not proceed promptly to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝命副使留粵調治，所存貢物十種，派員送京，失物毋庸補備。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the deputy envoy to remain in Guangdong for treatment; the ten kinds of tribute goods on hand were sent to the capital by assigned officials; lost items need not be replaced.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the deputy envoy to stay in Guangdong for treatment, had the ten surviving tribute items escorted to the capital, and said the lost goods need not be replaced.

sentences.zh: 且諭曰：「暹羅國王抒忱納贐，沿海申虔，即與到京齎呈無異。

translations.literal: And instructed: "The King of Siam expresses sincere devotion in presenting gifts, showing reverence along the coast—this is no different from bringing memorials to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "The King of Siam has shown sincere devotion in his gifts and reverence along the coast—no different from presenting tribute in the capital.

sentences.zh: 例賞物件及敕書，交兵部發交兩廣總督頒給。」

translations.literal: Scheduled reward items and the edict are to be issued through the Board of War to the governor-general of the two Guang provinces for conferral."
translations.idiomatic: The customary rewards and edict will be sent through the Board of War to the governor-general of the two Guang provinces for delivery."

sentences.zh: 明年，暹羅王聞貢船焚毀，補備方物入貢，遇颶風，船漂散。

translations.literal: The next year, hearing the tribute ships had burned, the King of Siam prepared replacement local products for tribute; encountering a typhoon, the ships were scattered adrift.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, learning the tribute ships had burned, the King of Siam prepared replacement tribute goods, but a typhoon scattered the vessels.

sentences.zh: 二十年秋，正副貢船先後抵粵，蔣攸銛以聞。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twentieth year, principal and deputy tribute ships successively reached Guangdong; Jiang Youqian reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of year twenty the principal and deputy tribute ships reached Guangdong in succession, and Jiang Youqian reported it.

sentences.zh: 仁宗嘉其恭順，諭曰：「暹羅向系三年一貢，明年又屆入貢之期。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong praised their reverent submission and instructed: "Siam has customarily presented tribute every three years; next year the tribute period falls due again.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong praised their reverence and said: "Siam has traditionally sent tribute every three years, and next year the tribute cycle comes due again.

sentences.zh: 此次方物，可作二十一年例貢。」

translations.literal: This time's local products may count as the regular tribute of the twenty-first year."
translations.idiomatic: Let this consignment count as the regular tribute for year twenty-one."

sentences.zh: 暹羅王復表請准用內地水手駕駛，部議駁之。

translations.literal: The King of Siam again memorialized requesting permission to use inland sailors as pilots; the ministry deliberated and rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Siam again petitioned to use Chinese sailors as pilots; the ministry rejected the request.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，暹羅遠征馬來半島開泰州，懸軍深入，破沙魯他軍，南下服派拉克，進與色蘭格耳國戰，以軍疲，由新格拉而還。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, Siam mounted a distant expedition to Songkhla on the Malay Peninsula, advancing deep with unsupported forces; defeated Salut's army, subjugated Pak Lat to the south, then fought Selangor; wearied, they returned from Singora.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 Siam launched a distant campaign against Songkhla on the Malay Peninsula, advancing deep with overextended forces; they defeated Salut, subdued Pak Lat to the south, fought Selangor, and withdrew from Singora when the army was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 三年，遣使入貢賀萬壽。

translations.literal: In the third year, dispatched envoys in tribute to congratulate on birthday celebrations.
translations.idiomatic: In year three envoys were sent to present birthday tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年，鄭佛在位十五年，傳位其子鄭福。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Zheng Fo having reigned fifteen years, transmitted the throne to his son Zheng Fu.
translations.idiomatic: In year four, after fifteen years on the throne, Zheng Fo abdicated in favor of his son Zheng Fu.

sentences.zh: 明年，遣使入貢請封，舟毀，貢物沉沒。

translations.literal: The next year, dispatched envoys in tribute seeking investiture; the boat was destroyed and tribute goods sank.
translations.idiomatic: The next year envoys were sent for tribute and investiture, but the vessel was wrecked and the tribute lost.

sentences.zh: 帝免補進，仍封鄭福為暹羅王。

translations.literal: The Emperor exempted replacement and still enfeoffed Zheng Fu as King of Siam.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor waived replacement and still invested Zheng Fu as King of Siam.

sentences.zh: 福朝貢益恭。

translations.literal: Fu's court tribute grew ever more reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Under Fu tribute grew ever more reverent.

sentences.zh: 十九年三月，宣宗以暹羅服事之勤，諭曰：「暹羅三年一貢，其改為四年。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the nineteenth year, Emperor Xuanzong, because of Siam's diligent service, instructed: "Siam presents tribute every three years; change this to every four years."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year nineteen Emperor Xuanzong, praising Siam's diligence, said: "Siam sends tribute every three years—change the interval to four."

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，鄭福卒，弟蒙格克托繼立，中國稱曰鄭明者是也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, Zheng Fu died; younger brother Mongkut succeeded; China called him Zheng Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 Zheng Fu died and was succeeded by his younger brother Mongkut—known in China as Zheng Ming.

sentences.zh: 明奉孝和睿皇后、宣宗成皇帝遺詔，遺使進香並齎遞表文、方物，慶賀登極。

translations.literal: Ming, following the posthumous edicts of Empress Xiaosheng and Emperor Xuanzong, dispatched envoys to offer incense and bear memorials and local products, congratulating on accession.
translations.idiomatic: Ming followed the posthumous edicts of Empress Xiaosheng and Emperor Xuanzong, sending envoys to offer incense and present memorials and local products to congratulate the new emperor on his accession.

sentences.zh: 又因例貢屆期，請將貢物一併呈進。

translations.literal: Also because the regular tribute term had arrived, requested that tribute goods be presented together.
translations.idiomatic: Because the regular tribute cycle had also come due, he asked to present those goods as well.

sentences.zh: 文宗命兩廣總督徐廣縉傳知臣毋庸來京，儀物、方物悉令齎回。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong ordered Governor-General Xu Guangjin to inform the envoys they need not come to the capital—all ritual objects and local products to be taken back.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong told Governor-General Xu Guangjin to inform the envoys that they need not come to the capital and should take all ritual objects and tribute goods back.

sentences.zh: 至應進例貢，現當國制，二十七月之內不受朝賀，並停止筵宴，俟嗣王請封時再行呈遞。

translations.literal: As for regular tribute due, the nation is now in mourning; within twenty-seven months court congratulations are not received and feasts are suspended—presentation to wait until the successor king requests investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Regular tribute must wait: the court was in mourning and for twenty-seven months would receive no congratulatory audiences or feasts; tribute would be accepted when the new king petitioned for investiture.

sentences.zh: 二年，徐廣縉奏：「暹羅國王遣使補進例貢，並請敕封，現已行抵粵東。」

translations.literal: In the second year, Xu Guangjin memorialized: "The King of Siam has dispatched envoys to present supplemental regular tribute and request edict enfeoffment; they have now reached eastern Guangdong."
translations.idiomatic: In year two Xu Guangjin reported: "The King of Siam has sent envoys with supplemental regular tribute and a petition for investiture; they have now reached eastern Guangdong."

sentences.zh: 帝命於封印前伴送來京；

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered escort to the capital before the court seal closes;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered them escorted to the capital before the court closed for the mourning seal;

sentences.zh: 應給嗣王誥命，俟貢使抵都發給齎回。

translations.literal: the patent for the successor king to be issued when tribute envoys reach the capital for them to carry back.
translations.idiomatic: the investiture patent would be issued when the envoys reached the capital for them to carry home.

sentences.zh: 靠粵匪亂熾，貢使竟不能至，入貢中國亦於此止。

translations.literal: But Guangdong bandit turmoil flared; the tribute envoys could not arrive after all—tribute to China ended here.
translations.idiomatic: But bandit turmoil in Guangdong intensified and the envoys never arrived—Chinese tribute ended here.

sentences.zh: 此後暹羅遂為自主之國矣。

translations.literal: Thereafter Siam became an independent state.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Siam became a fully independent kingdom.

sentences.zh: 鄭明通佛學，善英語，用歐人改制度，行新政，國治日隆，稱皇帝。

translations.literal: Zheng Ming mastered Buddhist learning, was skilled in English, employed Europeans to reform institutions, enacted new policies; governance daily prospered and he styled himself emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Ming was steeped in Buddhism, fluent in English, employed Europeans to reform institutions, and launched new policies; as the realm prospered he styled himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 復與英、法諸國訂約，遣使分駐各國。

translations.literal: He also concluded treaties with Britain, France, and other states, dispatching envoys stationed separately in each country.
translations.idiomatic: He also signed treaties with Britain, France, and others and posted envoys abroad.

sentences.zh: 同治七年，鄭明卒，子抽拉郎公繼立，廢奴隸，行立憲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi, Zheng Ming died; his son Chulalongkorn succeeded, abolished slavery, and instituted constitutional rule.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7 Zheng Ming died and was succeeded by his son Chulalongkorn, who abolished slavery and moved toward constitutional government.

sentences.zh: 北部亂賊蜂起，討平之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in swarms in the north; he suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose across the north and he suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 法既吞越南，復迫暹羅割湄江東地。

translations.literal: France having swallowed Vietnam, again pressed Siam to cede lands east of the Mekong.
translations.idiomatic: After annexing Vietnam, France pressed Siam to cede the lands east of the Mekong.

sentences.zh: 光緒十九年，國王派軍防守。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Guangxu, the king dispatched armies to defend.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 19 the king sent troops to defend the frontier.

sentences.zh: 法藉口暹羅侵越南，出兵占孔格沙丹格、托倫格二地，復進據老撾之加核蒙隆拍拉朋。

translations.literal: France, using Siam's encroachment on Vietnam as pretext, sent troops to occupy Kongka Sadung and Talung, then advanced to seize Khemmoune Louang Phrabang in Laos.
translations.idiomatic: Citing Siam's encroachment on Vietnam, France seized Kongka Sadung and Talung, then advanced to take Khemmoune Louang Phrabang in Laos.

sentences.zh: 暹軍敗退湄河西岸，法復以海軍攻盤穀海港，暹人懼，乞和。

translations.literal: Siamese armies were defeated and retreated to the west bank of the Mekong; France again attacked Paknam by sea; the Siamese feared and sued for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Siamese forces retreated to the west bank of the Mekong; France then attacked Paknam by sea, and Siam sued for peace in fear.

sentences.zh: 既，英人疾法日盛，不益於己，乃與法立約，保證湄南屬暹羅，暹羅賴以少安，致力內政，日蒸富強。

translations.literal: Then Britain, chafing at France's daily growth as unbeneficial to itself, concluded a treaty with France guaranteeing the Chao Phraya basin to Siam; Siam thereby found brief peace, devoted itself to internal governance, and daily grew rich and strong.
translations.idiomatic: Britain, uneasy at France's growing power, then made a treaty with France guaranteeing the Chao Phraya basin to Siam; Siam found a measure of peace, turned to domestic reform, and grew steadily stronger.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，卒，子馬活提路特立。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, he died; his son Mahavajiravudh succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 he died and was succeeded by his son Mahavajiravudh.

sentences.zh: 暹羅版圖，北緯六度至二十度，東經九十七度至一百七度。

translations.literal: Siam's territory spans six to twenty degrees north latitude and ninety-seven to one hundred seven degrees east longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Siam spans six to twenty degrees north latitude and ninety-seven to one hundred seven degrees east longitude.

sentences.zh: 官制，設外務、內務、財政、陸軍、海軍、司法、教育、農務、交通九部，佐國王管理國政。

translations.literal: In official structure, nine ministries are established—Foreign Affairs, Interior, Finance, Army, Navy, Justice, Education, Agriculture, and Communications—to assist the king in managing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The government comprises nine ministries—Foreign Affairs, Interior, Finance, Army, Navy, Justice, Education, Agriculture, and Communications—assisting the king in governing.

sentences.zh: 另設樞密院，國王選親貴勳臣充之，國之大事皆諮詢而行。

translations.literal: A privy council is separately established; the king selects princes, nobles, and meritorious ministers to fill it—all great affairs of state are consulted before action.
translations.idiomatic: A privy council of princes, nobles, and meritorious ministers advises the king on all major affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 中央稱畿甸省。

translations.literal: The center is called the Capital Province.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region is called the Capital Province.

sentences.zh: 全國分十七州，置總督。

translations.literal: The whole country is divided into seventeen provinces, each with a governor.
translations.idiomatic: The country is divided into seventeen provinces, each with a governor.

sentences.zh: 州下有縣、郡、村。

translations.literal: Below provinces are counties, districts, and villages.
translations.idiomatic: Below the provinces are counties, districts, and villages.

sentences.zh: 人口八百萬，中國人占三分之一。

translations.literal: Population eight million; Chinese compose one third.
translations.idiomatic: The population is eight million, about one third of them Chinese.

sentences.zh: 軍備仿德國徵兵制，常備軍三萬人，戰時可增十倍。

translations.literal: Military establishment follows Germany's conscription system; standing army thirty thousand, expandable tenfold in wartime.
translations.idiomatic: The army follows the German conscription model—thirty thousand regulars, expandable tenfold in war.

sentences.zh: 海軍有砲艦、水雷艇數艘。

translations.literal: The navy has several gunboats and torpedo boats.
translations.idiomatic: The navy maintains several gunboats and torpedo boats.

sentences.zh: 製造槍砲廠、造船所皆備。

translations.literal: Foundries for guns and cannon and shipyards are all provided.
translations.idiomatic: Gun foundries and shipyards are all in place.

sentences.zh: 暹羅疊出英君，政治修明，故介於英、法諸大國屬地，而能自保其獨立也。

translations.literal: Siam has produced successive wise rulers and refined governance; therefore, situated among British and French colonial domains, it has been able to preserve its independence.
translations.idiomatic: Siam has produced a succession of capable rulers and sound governance; surrounded by British and French colonial holdings, it has preserved its independence.

sentences.zh: 南掌，舊稱老撾。

translations.literal: Lan Xang—formerly called Laos.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Xang was formerly known as Laos.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，雲貴總督鄂爾泰疏言：「南掌國王島孫遣使奉銷金緬字編蒲表文一道、馴象二隻，求入貢。」

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Ortai memorialized: "King of Lan Xang Daosun dispatched envoys presenting one gold-inlaid Burmese-script memorial on palm leaf and two trained elephants, seeking tribute admission."
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 Governor-General Ortai reported: "The King of Lan Xang, Daosun, sent envoys with a gold-inlaid Burmese-script palm-leaf memorial and two trained elephants, seeking tributary admission."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉獎，其貢道命由普洱府入，沿途護送，從厚支給。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised this; the tribute route was ordered through Pu'er Prefecture, escorted along the way with generous provision.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised the gesture and ordered the tribute route through Pu'er Prefecture with generous escort and provisions along the way.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，遣使表貢，並請定貢期，命五年一貢。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, dispatched envoys with memorial tribute, also requesting fixed tribute intervals; ordered tribute every five years.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year eight envoys presented tribute and asked for a fixed schedule; tribute was set at once every five years.

sentences.zh: 賜之敕諭並文綺等物，令使臣齎捧回國。

translations.literal: Granted them an imperial edict and patterned silks and other items; ordered envoys to reverently carry them home.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict and patterned silks were granted for the envoys to carry home.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，表謝頒敕諭恩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, memorialized thanking for the grace of the issued edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year nine they memorialized thanks for the imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，賜國王島孫彩緞、文綺。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, granted King Daosun colored satin and patterned silks.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 King Daosun was granted colored satin and patterned silks.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，帝以南掌遠道致貢，改為十年一次。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, the Emperor, because Lan Xang came from far to present tribute, changed the interval to once every ten years.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year eight the Emperor, noting Lan Xang's long journey, changed the tribute interval to once every ten years.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，貢馴象。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year, presented trained elephants.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year fourteen they sent trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月，國王准第駕公滿奏言：「臣母喃瑪喇提拉同臣遣使奉表，進馴象二隻，慶賀皇上五旬萬壽，皇太后七旬萬壽。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year, King Zhundijiagongman memorialized: "My mother Nanmalatila and I dispatch envoys bearing memorials, presenting two trained elephants to celebrate the Emperor's fiftieth birthday and the Empress Dowager's seventieth."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year twenty-six King Zhundijiagongman reported: "My mother Nanmalatila and I send envoys with memorials and two trained elephants to celebrate the Emperor's fiftieth birthday and the Empress Dowager's seventieth."

sentences.zh: 准第駕公滿又別備表文一、貢象二，宴賞如例。

translations.literal: Zhundijiagongman also separately prepared one memorial and two tribute elephants; feasts and rewards followed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhundijiagongman also sent a separate memorial and two elephants; feasts and rewards followed precedent.

sentences.zh: 六月十三日，禮臣議：「嗣後各省巡撫值南掌、琉球、蘇祿、安南等國貢使到境，遴委同知、通判中一員，武弁守備一員，伴行長送至京，並知照經過各省添派妥員護送，按省更替；

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the sixth month, ritual officials deliberated: "Hereafter when provincial governors encounter tribute envoys from Lan Xang, Ryukyu, Sulu, Annam, and other states arriving at their borders, select one subprefect from among assistant prefects and one military officer of garrison-command rank to escort them the full way to the capital, notifying each province passed to assign proper officials for escort, replacing by province;
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day of the sixth month the Board of Rites proposed: "When tribute envoys from Lan Xang, Ryukyu, Sulu, Annam, and other states reach a province, the governor is to assign one subprefect and one garrison commander to escort them to the capital, with each province along the route providing relays in turn;

sentences.zh: 貢使回國，亦一例辦理。」

translations.literal: when tribute envoys return home, handle likewise."
translations.idiomatic: the same arrangement applies when envoys return home."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「南掌外籓入貢使臣，俱於陳設鹵簿之日，帶領道旁瞻仰天顏，備觀儀典。

translations.literal: Also memorialized: "Tribute envoys from Lan Xang and other outer feudatories, on the day the imperial guard of honor is deployed, are all to be led roadside to behold the imperial countenance and fully observe ceremonial rites.
translations.idiomatic: They also proposed: "On days when the imperial guard of honor is deployed, envoys from Lan Xang and other outer feudatories should be led to the roadside to behold the Emperor and observe the full ceremonial display.

sentences.zh: 今國王准第駕公滿遣使叭哩細哩門遮昆來京，擬於七月初八日聖駕起鑾之期，帶領大東門道旁叩見。」

translations.literal: Now King Zhundijiagongman has dispatched envoy Balixilimen Zhekun to the capital; it is proposed on the eighth day of the seventh month, when the sacred carriage departs, to lead him beside the Great East Gate for audience."
translations.idiomatic: King Zhundijiagongman's envoy Balixilimen Zhekun has come to the capital; on the eighth day of the seventh month, when the imperial procession departs, he is to be brought to the roadside at the Great East Gate for audience."

sentences.zh: 四十七年，國王召翁遣使臣叭整哄等四人入貢，帝於山高水長連日賜茶果，又賜宴於紫光閣、三無私殿。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year, King Zhao Ong sent four envoys including Bazhenghong in tribute; the Emperor repeatedly granted tea and fruit at the Shan Gao Shui Chang pavilion and feasts at the Ziguang Pavilion and Sanwusi Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-seven King Zhao Ong sent four envoys including Bazhenghong in tribute; the Emperor repeatedly granted tea and fruit at the Shan Gao Shui Chang pavilion and feasts at the Ziguang Pavilion and Sanwusi Hall.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，國王表貢馴象祝釐，並附進例貢。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, the king memorialized and presented trained elephants for birthday blessings, also attaching regular tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-five the king sent trained elephants for birthday blessings along with regular tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝諭雲貴總督富綱派員護送。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Fugang to dispatch officials for escort.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Governor-General Fugang to provide an escort.

sentences.zh: 南掌貢使定於七月二十日至熱河行在，與蒙古王公、各外籓貢使同預壽筵。

translations.literal: Lan Xang tribute envoys were fixed to reach the Rehe traveling palace on the twentieth day of the seventh month, joining Mongol princes and outer feudatory envoys in the birthday feast.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Xang envoys were scheduled to reach the Rehe traveling palace on the twentieth day of the seventh month and join Mongol princes and other feudatory envoys at the birthday feast.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，諭免例進貢象。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year, instructed exemption from regular tribute elephants.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-eight the court waived the regular tribute of elephants.

sentences.zh: 明年，國王召溫猛遣使請封，特頒誥敕，並駝鈕鍍金銀印，交使臣齎回。

translations.literal: The next year, King Zhao Wenmeng dispatched envoys requesting investiture; patent and edict were specially issued, along with camel-knob gilded silver seal, for envoys to carry back.
translations.idiomatic: The next year King Zhao Wenmeng sent envoys seeking investiture; patent, edict, and a gilded silver seal with a camel-shaped knob were specially issued for them to carry home.

sentences.zh: 六十年，國王奉表祝釐，進長生經一卷、阿魏二十斤、象牙四十、夷錦四十。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, the king presented a memorial for birthday blessings, sending one scroll of the Longevity Sutra, twenty jin of asafetida, forty [measures] of ivory, and forty bolts of foreign brocade.
translations.idiomatic: In year sixty the king sent birthday tribute: one scroll of the Longevity Sutra, twenty jin of asafetida, forty measures of ivory, and forty bolts of foreign brocade.

sentences.zh: 時召溫猛已播遷越南昭晉州地，既受敕印，仍未能返國。

translations.literal: At the time Zhao Wenmeng had already been driven into exile in Zhaojin Prefecture, Vietnam; though he received patent and seal, he still could not return home.
translations.idiomatic: By then Zhao Wenmeng had been driven into exile in Zhaojin Prefecture in Vietnam; though he received patent and seal, he still could not return home.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，國王遣使齎表，懇求赴京進香。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, the king dispatched envoys bearing memorials, earnestly requesting to go to the capital to offer incense.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 the king sent envoys with memorials earnestly asking to go to the capital to offer incense.

sentences.zh: 帝諭止之，令雲貴督臣由驛進呈金葉表文，所貢檀香三枝交太常寺。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed them to desist, ordering Yunnan-Guizhou governors to present the gold-leaf memorial by courier; the three branches of sandalwood presented were handed to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused and ordered the Yunnan-Guizhou governors to forward the gold-leaf memorial by courier; the three branches of sandalwood tribute were handed to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 十二年，國王遣使進馴象四隻、象牙四百斤、犀角三十斤、土絹一疋，帝賞賚有加。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the king dispatched envoys presenting four trained elephants, four hundred jin of ivory, thirty jin of rhinoceros horn, and one bolt of native silk; the Emperor granted rewards beyond the usual.
translations.idiomatic: In year twelve the king sent four trained elephants, four hundred jin of ivory, thirty jin of rhinoceros horn, and one bolt of native silk; the Emperor granted unusually generous rewards.

sentences.zh: 十四年，越南國王阮福映遣使恭繳南掌敕印。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, King of Vietnam Nguyen Phuc Anh dispatched envoys reverently surrendering Lan Xang's patent and seal.
translations.idiomatic: In year fourteen King Nguyen Phuc Anh of Vietnam sent envoys to surrender Lan Xang's patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 帝諭曰：「南掌國王召溫猛忄耎懦不振，流徙越南，遺棄敕印，朕念其流離，不加聲責，豈能復掌國事？

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed: "King of Lan Xang Zhao Wenmeng is weak and feckless, exiled in Vietnam, having abandoned patent and seal; considering his displacement, I add no rebuke—how could he resume governing the state?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "King Zhao Wenmeng of Lan Xang is weak and feckless, exiled in Vietnam, and has abandoned his patent and seal; considering his displacement I add no rebuke—but how could he resume governing the state?

sentences.zh: 聽其在越南居住可也。

translations.literal: Let him dwell in Vietnam—that is acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Let him remain in Vietnam—that is acceptable.

sentences.zh: 其國事以其伯召蛇榮代辦。」

translations.literal: State affairs are to be handled on his behalf by his uncle Zhao Sherong."
translations.idiomatic: State affairs are to be handled on his behalf by his uncle Zhao Sherong."

sentences.zh: 二十四年，召蛇榮子召蟒塔度臘虔修職貢，籥懇再頒敕印。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Zhao Sherong's son Zhao Mangtadula dutifully maintained tribute duties and earnestly pleaded for reissue of patent and seal.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-four Zhao Sherong's son Zhao Mangtadula dutifully maintained tribute and earnestly pleaded for reissue of patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 禮臣覆稱前繳印信字畫完好，毋庸另鑄，准於頒給敕印外，再給誥命一道，交召蟒塔度臘祇領。

translations.literal: Ritual officials replied that the previously surrendered seal's characters were intact and need not be recast; approved, besides issuing patent and seal, to additionally grant one patent of investiture for Zhao Mangtadula to receive reverently.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Rites replied that the surrendered seal's characters were intact and need not be recast; besides reissuing patent and seal, one investiture patent was additionally granted for Zhao Mangtadula to receive.

sentences.zh: 道光二十二年，遣使齎敕封召喇嘛呢呀宮滿為南掌國王。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Daoguang, dispatched envoys bearing edict enfeoffing Zhao Lamaniagongman as King of Lan Xang.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 22 envoys were sent with an investiture edict enfeoffing Zhao Lamaniagongman as King of Lan Xang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，南掌國長召整塔提拉宮滿遣使叩關，請入貢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng, Lan Xang chief Zhao Zhengtatilagongman dispatched envoys knocking at the border gate, requesting tribute admission.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3 Lan Xang chief Zhao Zhengtatilagongman sent envoys to the border requesting tributary admission.

sentences.zh: 帝以南掌貢使向由貴州、湖南、湖北、河南取道進京，惟現在粵匪未盡殲除，命雲貴督臣吳文鎔等即傳諭南掌使臣，此次毋庸來京，仍優與犒賞，俾先行回國。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Lan Xang tribute envoys had customarily traveled through Guizhou, Hunan, Hubei, and Henan to reach the capital—but Guangdong bandits were not yet fully suppressed—ordered Yunnan-Guizhou governors Wu Wenrong and others immediately to inform Lan Xang envoys that this time they need not come to the capital, still granting generous rewards for them to return home first.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Xang envoys had customarily traveled through Guizhou, Hunan, Hubei, and Henan to reach the capital—but with Guangdong bandits not yet fully suppressed, the Emperor ordered Governors Wu Wenrong and others to tell the Lan Xang envoys not to come to the capital this time, granting generous rewards for them to return home first.

sentences.zh: 貢物象只即由督臣派員送京。

translations.literal: Tribute ivory was immediately sent to the capital by officials dispatched by the governor.
translations.idiomatic: The tribute ivory was sent to the capital by officials dispatched by the governor.

sentences.zh: 然自是雲南回匪亂起，貢道遂絕。

translations.literal: But then Yunnan Hui rebellions broke out and the tribute route was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Then Yunnan Hui rebellions broke out and the tribute route was cut off.

sentences.zh: 時南掌兼貢越南之順化，暹羅之曼谷。

translations.literal: At the time Lan Xang also paid tribute to Thanh Hoa in Vietnam and Bangkok in Siam.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Lan Xang also paid tribute to Thanh Hoa in Vietnam and Bangkok in Siam.

sentences.zh: 嗣越南衰，南掌入暹羅，號為暹羅屬國。

translations.literal: Later, as Vietnam declined, Lan Xang passed under Siam and was styled a Siam dependency.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as Vietnam declined, Lan Xang passed under Siam and became a Siamese dependency.

sentences.zh: 光緒十一年，法人得越南全境，以南掌地居湄公江中間，為傳教通商孔道，復設法保護之，於是南掌又折入於法矣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Guangxu, France having gained all Vietnam, because Lan Xang's lands lay between the Mekong and served as a channel for missionary work and trade, again established French protection—thus Lan Xang was absorbed into France.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11, after France took all of Vietnam, Lan Xang—lying between Mekong channels and serving as a route for missionaries and trade—came under French protection and was absorbed into France.

sentences.zh: 南掌國都曰隆勃剌邦，據湄公江左岸，江東折南流，南岡江自東來會，曲注如玦環，城在山下，當南岡江會流處，水穿城而過。

translations.literal: The capital of Lan Xang is called Luang Prabang, on the left bank of the Mekong; east of the river it bends south; the Nangang River comes from the east to join it, curving in like a jade ring; the city lies below the hills at the Nangang confluence, water passing through the city.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Xang's capital is Luang Prabang, on the Mekong's left bank; east of the river the current bends south; the Nangang River joins from the east in a jade-ring curve; the city lies below the hills at that confluence, with water running through it.

sentences.zh: 王宮在城之北，背山建屋，規制壯麗。

translations.literal: The royal palace is north of the city, buildings backed against the hills, magnificent in scale.
translations.idiomatic: The royal palace stands north of the city, backed against the hills, magnificent in scale.

sentences.zh: 佛墓寺塔森立城市中。

translations.literal: Buddhist tombs, temples, and pagodas stand densely in the city.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist tombs, temples, and pagodas stand densely throughout the city.

sentences.zh: 瀕江兩岸多花園。

translations.literal: Both banks along the river have many gardens.
translations.idiomatic: Both banks of the river are lined with gardens.

sentences.zh: 居民大半老撾種，或喀木種。

translations.literal: Most inhabitants are Lao, or Khmu.
translations.idiomatic: Most of the inhabitants are Lao, or Khmu.

sentences.zh: 老撾種人俗同暹羅，不文身雕題，性愚而嬾。

translations.literal: The Lao people resemble the Siamese in custom; they do not tattoo their bodies or carve their foreheads, and their nature is dull and lazy.
translations.idiomatic: The Lao shared Siamese customs but did not tattoo or scar their bodies; they were regarded as simple and indolent by temperament.

sentences.zh: 奉佛教，好生惡殺。

translations.literal: They follow Buddhism, cherish life, and abhor killing.
translations.idiomatic: They practiced Buddhism, cherished life, and abhorred killing.

sentences.zh: 務耕種、畜牧，能鑄造、紡織。

translations.literal: They devote themselves to farming and herding and can cast metal and weave cloth.
translations.idiomatic: They farmed, raised livestock, and knew metalworking and weaving.

sentences.zh: 其狀貌短小，鼻寬而脣厚，膚色紅紫，剪發留頂，不蓄須。

translations.literal: In appearance they are short, with broad noses and thick lips, reddish-purple skin, hair cut short with the crown left, and no beards.
translations.idiomatic: They were short in stature, with broad noses, thick lips, and reddish skin; they cropped their hair but left the crown, and wore no beards.

sentences.zh: 男子衣飾，橫布一幅圍腰至膝，富貴者以紬緞為之。

translations.literal: Men's dress is a horizontal cloth wrapped from the waist to the knee; the wealthy use silk and satin.
translations.idiomatic: Men wore a single cloth wrapped from waist to knee; the wealthy used silk and satin.

sentences.zh: 婦人下裳似裙，上服摺蓋於胸，發黝黑，鬢垂於後項，耳手足皆帶環圈，以金銀銅為飾。

translations.literal: Women wear skirt-like lower garments and fold upper garments over the chest; their hair is black, hanging at the nape; ears, hands, and feet all bear rings of gold, silver, or copper.
translations.idiomatic: Women wore skirt-like lower garments and folded upper garments across the chest; their black hair hung at the nape, and they adorned ears, hands, and feet with gold, silver, or copper rings.

sentences.zh: 其房屋率用藤竹縛造。

translations.literal: Their houses are generally bound together from rattan and bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary houses were built of lashed rattan and bamboo.

sentences.zh: 富室官衙則用堅木，極壯麗。

translations.literal: The mansions of the rich and government offices use hardwood and are extremely grand.
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy homes and official halls were built of hardwood and were very imposing.

sentences.zh: 常食睟米，雜以秔稻。

translations.literal: They regularly eat glutinous rice mixed with long-grain rice.
translations.idiomatic: Their staple was glutinous rice mixed with long-grain rice.

sentences.zh: 中國人教以制酒醴、養蠶絲之法。

translations.literal: Chinese taught them methods of brewing wine and raising silkworms for silk.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese taught them to brew liquor and raise silkworms.

sentences.zh: 家畜象、牛，供耕田馱貨。

translations.literal: Households keep elephants and cattle for plowing fields and carrying goods.
translations.idiomatic: Households kept elephants and cattle for farming and transport.

sentences.zh: 其物產有五金各礦，稻則有秔有睟，多包穀，少粟麥，有靛青、漆、藤、竹、麻、棉、椰葉、桄榔、甘蔗、檳榔、豆蔻、煙葉、芝麻、花生，而松木、楢木尤多。

translations.literal: Their products include mines of the five metals; among grains there are long-grain and glutinous rice, much maize and little millet or wheat; indigo, lacquer, rattan, bamboo, hemp, cotton, coconut leaves, sugar palm, sugarcane, betel, cardamom, tobacco, sesame, and peanuts—and pine and oak are especially abundant.
translations.idiomatic: They produced ores of the five metals, long-grain and glutinous rice, mostly maize with little millet or wheat, indigo, lacquer, rattan, bamboo, hemp, cotton, coconut, sugar palm, sugarcane, betel, cardamom, tobacco, sesame, peanuts, and especially pine and oak timber.

sentences.zh: 其貨幣或用暹羅之體格，或印度之魯卑，皆銀錢也。

translations.literal: Their currency uses either Siam's tical or India's rupee—both silver coins.
translations.idiomatic: Currency was either the Siamese tical or the Indian rupee—both silver.

sentences.zh: 此外或用銅錢、用鐵錢，或用銀錠、用海貝。

translations.literal: Besides these they also use copper cash, iron cash, silver ingots, or cowrie shells.
translations.idiomatic: They also used copper or iron cash, silver ingots, or cowrie shells.

sentences.zh: 然用錢頗少，以貨易者為多。

translations.literal: Yet coin is used rather little; barter is more common.
translations.idiomatic: Coin was little used; barter predominated.

sentences.zh: 天氣溫和，自二月至八月多東風、多雨，九月至正月多北風、多晴雲。

translations.literal: The climate is mild; from the second to the eighth month there are mostly east winds and much rain; from the ninth month to the first month mostly north winds and clear skies.
translations.idiomatic: The climate was mild: February through August brought east winds and heavy rain; September through January brought north winds and fair weather.

sentences.zh: 蘇祿，南洋島國也。

translations.literal: Sulu is an island state of the Southern Seas.
translations.idiomatic: Sulu was an island kingdom of the Southern Seas.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，蘇祿國王毋漢未母拉律林遣使奉表，貢方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, Sulu's king Muhanweimulalülin sent envoys bearing a memorial and tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, King Muhanweimulalülin of Sulu sent envoys with a memorial and tribute gifts.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，貢使至京，貢珍珠、玳瑁、花布、金頭牙薩白幼洋布、蘇山竹布、燕窩、龍頭、花刀、夾花標槍、滿花番刀、藤席、猿十二種。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year the tribute envoys reached the capital, presenting pearls, tortoiseshell, patterned cloth, gold-headed ivory fine foreign cloth, Sulu bamboo cloth, bird's nests, dragon heads, patterned knives, inlaid spears, fully patterned foreign swords, rattan mats, and twelve kinds of gibbon.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year the envoys reached Beijing with pearls, tortoiseshell, patterned cloth, fine foreign textiles, Sulu bamboo cloth, bird's nests, carved dragon heads, patterned knives, inlaid spears, foreign swords, rattan mats, and twelve kinds of gibbon.

sentences.zh: 賜宴賚賞，頒敕諭一道，令使臣齎回。

translations.literal: They were granted banquets and rewards, and one imperial edict was issued for the envoys to carry home.
translations.idiomatic: The court gave banquets and gifts and issued an imperial edict for the envoys to carry home.

sentences.zh: 定期五年一貢，貢道由福建。

translations.literal: Tribute was fixed at once every five years, via the Fujian route.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute was fixed at once every five years via Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月，國王奉表謝恩，並奏：「伊祖東王於明永樂間入朝，歸至德州病故。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eleventh year the king submitted a memorial of thanks and also reported: "My ancestor the Eastern King came to court in the Ming Yongle reign; on his return he died of illness at Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eleventh year the king sent a memorial of thanks, reporting: "My ancestor the Eastern King visited the Ming court in the Yongle reign and died of illness at Dezhou on his return.

sentences.zh: 帝命有司營葬，勒碑墓道，諡曰『恭定』，留妻妾傔從十人守墓。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered officials to arrange burial, erect a stele on the tomb road, and grant the posthumous title 'Respectful and Steadfast'; ten wives, concubines, and attendants were left to guard the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a burial, a stele on the tomb road, and the posthumous title Respectful and Steadfast; ten wives, concubines, and attendants were left to guard the tomb.

sentences.zh: 畢三年喪，遣歸。

translations.literal: When the three-year mourning was complete, they were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: After three years' mourning they were sent home.

sentences.zh: 今事隔三百餘年，所有墳墓及其子孫存留周恤之處，懇請修理給復。」

translations.literal: Now more than three hundred years have passed; we earnestly request repair and restoration of the tomb and of the care provided to the descendants who remain."
translations.idiomatic: More than three hundred years have passed; we earnestly ask that the tomb be repaired and support for the descendants who remain be restored."

sentences.zh: 禮臣議覆：「蘇祿國東王巴都噶叭哈答歿，長子都馬含歸國襲封。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites replied: "When Sulu's Eastern King Paduka Pahala died, his eldest son Tumahao returned home to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites replied: "When Sulu's Eastern King Paduka Pahala died, his eldest son Tumahao returned to succeed.

sentences.zh: 次子安都祿，三子溫哈喇，留居守塋，其子孫以祖名分為安、溫二姓，應如所請。

translations.literal: The second son, Andulu, and the third son, Wenhaluo, remained to guard the grave; their descendants took the ancestral names and divided into the An and Wen surnames—this should be granted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The second son Andulu and third son Wenhaluo stayed to guard the grave; their descendants formed the An and Wen clans—the request should be granted.

sentences.zh: 飭查王墓所有神道享亭、牌坊，修理整飭，於安、溫二姓中各遴一人給頂戴奉祀。

translations.literal: Order an inspection of the spirit way, offering pavilions, and memorial arch at the king's tomb, repair and put them in order, and select one man each from the An and Wen clans to receive official caps and perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Inspect and repair the spirit way, offering halls, and memorial arch; select one man each from the An and Wen clans to receive official rank and perform sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 著為例。」

translations.literal: Establish this as precedent."
translations.idiomatic: Let this become precedent."

sentences.zh: 帝允之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五年八月，蘇祿國王麻喊味呵稟朥甯遣番丁護送遭風商人回內地。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year of Qianlong, Sulu's king Mahamuidiha sent men from Bingning to escort merchants who had been shipwrecked back to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Qianlong year five, King Mahamuidiha of Sulu sent men from Bingning to escort shipwrecked merchants home.

sentences.zh: 八年，貢使馬明光奏請三年後復修朝貢，帝命仍遵雍正五年所定五年一貢之例。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, tribute envoy Ma Mingguang asked to resume court tribute after three years; the emperor ordered that the Yongzheng fifth-year rule of tribute once every five years still be followed.
translations.idiomatic: In year eight envoy Ma Mingguang asked to resume tribute after three years; the emperor upheld the Yongzheng rule of tribute every five years.

sentences.zh: 十九年，蘇祿國王麻喊味安柔律噒遣使貢方物，並貢國土一包，請以戶口人丁編入中國圖籍。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Sulu's king Mahamuidianroulüsi sent envoys with tribute goods and also presented a packet of soil from the realm, asking that the population be registered in China's household registers.
translations.idiomatic: In year nineteen King Mahamuidianroulüsi sent tribute and a packet of native soil, asking that his people be registered in Chinese household rolls.

sentences.zh: 帝諭：「蘇祿國傾心向化，其國之土地人民即在統御照臨之內，毋庸復行齎送圖冊。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Sulu has turned its heart toward civilization; its land and people are already within our rule and oversight—there is no need to send maps and registers again."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Sulu has turned wholeheartedly toward civilization; its land and people are already under our rule—there is no need to send maps and registers again."

sentences.zh: 二十八年，國王遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the king sent envoys with tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-eight the king again sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 自後遂不復至。

translations.literal: After that they came no more.
translations.idiomatic: After that no further missions came.

sentences.zh: 蘇祿本巫來由番族，悍勇善鬥。

translations.literal: Sulu was originally of the Malay race, fierce and skilled in fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Sulu was originally a Malay people, fierce and warlike.

sentences.zh: 西班牙既據呂宋，欲以蘇祿為屬國，蘇祿不從，西人以兵攻之，為所敗。

translations.literal: After Spain seized Luzon, it wished to make Sulu a dependency; Sulu refused, the Spaniards attacked by force, and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: After Spain seized Luzon it sought to subjugate Sulu; Sulu refused, Spanish troops attacked, and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 獨慕義中國，累世朝貢不絕。

translations.literal: Alone it admired China's righteousness and sent tribute generation after generation without cease.
translations.idiomatic: It alone admired China and sent tribute for generations without fail.

sentences.zh: 其國小，有巉岩之嶺，其極南為石崎山、犀角嶼、珠池，因島環繞。

translations.literal: The country is small, with rugged rocky ridges; at the far south are Stone Cape Mountain, Rhinoceros Horn Islet, and the pearl beds, ringed by islands.
translations.idiomatic: The kingdom was small, with rugged ridges; at its southern extremity lay Stone Cape, Rhinoceros Horn Islet, and pearl banks amid encircling islands.

sentences.zh: 海內有珍珠，土人與華商市易，大者利數十倍。

translations.literal: Pearls are found in the sea; natives trade with Chinese merchants, and large ones yield profits many times over.
translations.idiomatic: Pearls were harvested offshore and traded with Chinese merchants; the largest brought profits tenfold or more.

sentences.zh: 此外土產則蘇木、豆蔻、降香、藤條、蓽茇、鸚鵡之類。

translations.literal: Other local products include sappanwood, cardamom, eaglewood, rattan, long pepper, parrots, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Other products included sappanwood, cardamom, eaglewood, rattan, long pepper, and parrots.

sentences.zh: 戶口繁多。

translations.literal: The population is numerous.
translations.idiomatic: The population was large.

sentences.zh: 地磽瘠，食不足，常糴於別島。

translations.literal: The land is barren and lean; food is insufficient, and grain is often bought from other islands.
translations.idiomatic: The land was poor; food was scarce and grain often imported from neighboring islands.

sentences.zh: 土人奉回教。

translations.literal: The natives follow Islam.
translations.idiomatic: The people followed Islam.

sentences.zh: 與婆羅洲芒佳瑟民結為海盜云。

translations.literal: It is said they joined with the Mangkasar people of Borneo as sea pirates.
translations.idiomatic: They were said to have joined the Mangkasar people of Borneo in piracy at sea.
